The world of Lego City appears in Go Mini Man Go!
The world of Lego Space appears in Go Mini Man Go!

Go, Diego, Go!.description: Go, Diego, Go! is a spin-off of Dora the Explorer.
Go, Diego, Go! characters dance to songs in Nickelodeon Dance.
Diego appears in Team Umizoomi & Dora's Fantastic Flight.

GoBots.description: Tonka GoBots have been included as being part of the Transformers multiverse.
Gobots is parodied in the Robot Chicken episode "Book Of Corrine".
GoBots is mentioned in Ready Player One.
GoBots is mentioned in The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special.

Goat Simulator.description: There are multiple references to The Elder Scrolls in the Goat Simulator game series.
Goat Simulator features a modifier called "Yoshi Goat", that lets the goat eat things and lay eggs.
Pilgor from Goat Simulator is a playable character in SpeedRunners.
Goat MMO Simulator features an area based on Diablo.
A Goat toy appears as an object in Catlateral Damage.
I am Bread features a mode with the goat from Goat Simulator as a playable character. Goat Simulator features a transformation into a slice of bread from I am Bread.
A heist taking place in the world of Goat Simulator was added in Payday 2, while a Payday-themed expansion was added to Goat Simulator.
Goat from Goat Simulator is a playable character in Indie Game Battle.
Antennas based on Goat Simulator were included in Rocket League patch v1.17.
The pre-order "All-Stars" pack for Worms W.M.D. includes masks of goats from Goat Simulator and Goat-on-a-Rope as a craftable weapon.
Any Malu, Mordecai and Rigby play Goat Simulator in "MEU PRIMEIRO GAMEPLAY!! FT. MORDECAI E RIGBY".
A Goat skin is available in Fortnite by pre-ordering Goat Simulator 3 on the Epic Games Launcher.

Goat Simulator 3 contains the quest The Big Red Button which involves detonating an atomic bomb. The quest rewards the player with a Vault 55 suit which is named Fallout Boi. The item description reads "Goat. Goat never changes" in reference to the Fallout Series tagline.
A pinball table based on Goat Simulator was added to the Pinball FX series starting with Pinball FX that features characters from the series.

Goblin Slayer.description: The Goblin Slayer appeared in Valkyrie Anatomia: The Origin as part of a special collaboration.
Goblin Slayer is parodied in the Perfect Cell Vs episode "Perfect Cell Vs Goblin Slayer."
Goblin Slayer characters appear in Grand Summoners for a collaboration event.
Goblin Slayer characters appear in Crusaders Quest for a collaboration event.
Goblin Slayer characters appear in the Japanese version of The King of Fighters '98 Ultimate Match Online as part of a special collaboration.
Goblin Slayer characters appear in DanMachi: Memoria Freese as part of a special collaboration.
Goblin Slayer characters appear in Ikki Tousen: Extra Burst as part of a special collaboration.
Goblin Slayer appeared in Puzzle & Dragons during the GA Bunko collaboration event.

God Eater.description: Taiko no Tatsujin: Portable 2 and later games in the series feature music tracks from the God Eater series.
Pro Baseball Famista 2011 features Soma and Shio from God Eater as guest players, while Pro Yakyuu Famista Climax features Alisa and Vajra.
Costumes based on THE iDOLM@STER can be obtained in God Eater 2 as DLC.
Alisa and Ciel appear in Shin-Gun Destroy! Girl's Tank Battalion as a part of a collaboration.
Ace Combat Infinity features emblems based on God Eater 2 Rage Burst and God Eater Resurrection as part of two limited collaboration events.
The character God Eater from Megadimension Neptunia VII is based on the God Eater series.

Alisa and Claire plus costumes from God Eater Resonant Ops appear in Tales of the Rays and several Tales of characters appear in Resonant Ops as part of a limited collaboration event for each game; God Eater Burst features a DLC costume of Asbel and Cheria from Tales of Graces, while God Eater 2 Rage Burst and Tales of Zestiria feature DLC costumes of characters from each series as part of a special collaboration and Tales of Link features four costumes based on God Eater 2 characters as part of a second special collaboration, and the Tales of Arise artifact "Hellmask Fiend Skull" is from one of the monsters in God Eater.
Weapons and items based on God Eater appear in Code Vein as part of the pre-order DLC pack.

God Hand.description: There are minor references to Fist of the North Star in God Hand.
God Hand's ending theme is a parody of the ending theme in Mazinger Z.
Dr. Ion's boss battles from God Hand are parodies of the many Getter Robo mecha configurations.
One of Gene's moves and a minor enemy in God Hand references the Street Fighter series, one of Cody's costume colors in Street Fighter V is based on Gene.
The God Hand knife-thrower enemies are designed after El Gado/Hollywood from Final Fight.
The Chihuahua "Viewtiful Pup" in the Chihuahua race minigame from God Hand is named after Viewtiful Joe; there are other minor references to Viewtiful Joe.
The Chihuahua "Fission Mailed" in the Chihuahua race minigame from God Hand is named after a certain scene in Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of the Patriots.
The Chihuahua "Amaterasu" in the Chihuahua race minigame from God Hand is named after Ōkami's protagonist.
The Chihuahua "37 in a Row" in the Chihuahua race minigame from God Hand is named after a scene in Clerks.
There are minor references to Devil May Cry in God Hand.
Gene from God Hand appears as a card in Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3.

God of War.description: Kratos's Blades and armor appear in Heavenly Sword.
The North American and European versions of Everybody's Golf 5 feature Kratos as an DLC golfer.
The song "The End Begins (to Rock)" from God of War II was featured in Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock as free DLC for PlayStation 3 users.
Kratos costume are downloadable in LittleBigPlanet.
Kratos from God of War is a guest character in SoulCalibur: Broken Destiny.
Kratos is downloadable in ModNation Racers.
Kratos has been a subject for Death Battle!
Kratos is a guest character in the PlayStation 3 and Vita versions of the 2011 game Mortal Kombat.
Kratos' Blades of Chaos from God of War are seen as part of Calypso's collection in Twisted Metal (2012).
Kratos appears in Clássicos do Cinema - Turma da Mônica #32.
Heavy Kong from One-Punch Man greatly resembles Kratos from God of War.

PlayStation All-Stars Battle Royale features Kratos from God of War as a playable character. God of War Ragnarök features a conversation between Kratos and Mimir that references the events of PlayStation All-Stars Battle Royale.
The armor and weapons of King Leonidas from 300 are a pre-order bonus for God of War: Ascension multiplayer.
Geometry Dash features a skin based on a Kratos.
Frank Underwood was about to play God of War: Ascension in Chapter 15 of House of Cards.
Skin Pack 2 in the PlayStation versions of Minecraft Legacy Console and Bedrock Editions features skins based off characters from God of War', along with the Minecraft 2nd Birthday Skin Pack.
Several "God of War" summons were available during special collaborations.
In The Order: 1886, you can find a poster which references God of War. Additionally, God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on the The Order: 1886.
In the Playstation version of Shovel Knight, Kratos from God of War will appear as a boss.
Kratos is a playable character in Hurdle Turtle Forever.
The Torn-Away Pack for Tearaway Unfolded included a costume based on Kratos from God of War as well as a decoration based on the game.
Kratos has been a subject for DBX.
God of War (2018) is shown in "5 DICAS SURREAIS - OS GAMES DO WILLEN".
God of War was reviewed by S.A.R.A. on Toonami.
Random Encounters has made a God of War song.
Kratos is mentioned in the Console Wars episode "XBOX FINAL SUPRISE".
Kratos appears in Fortnite.

An arrangement of origami figures can be found in Ghost of Tsushima, one of them referencing God of War. Additionally, an outfit based on God of War can be obtained in Ghost of Tsushima. God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on the Ghost of Tsushima.
The Warrior skull and it's awakenings are based on Kratos from God of War.
Rick and Morty appear in a crossover promo for God of War Ragnarök.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on the Horizon series.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on MLB: The Show.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on The Last of Us.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on Ratchet and Clank.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on Death Stranding.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on Uncharted.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on Journey.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on Bloodborne.
God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on Days Gone.
God of War is mentioned in The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special.
God of War is parodied in multiple Siege Tales episodes.
"Video Games" by Tenacious D includes a brief segment referencing God of War.
An armor set based on Kratos from God of War appears in Destiny 2.
God of War memorabilia can be seen in the Melvins Macabre episode "NOSTALGIA".

Bots can be found playing a game resembling God of War called "Bot of War" in Astro's Playroom. Additionally you can also find bots resembling Kratos and his son. God of War Ragnarök features a poem based on the Astro Bot. Costumes based on various characters from God of War can be found in Astro Bot. Artwork of Kratos and Atreus interacting with Astro Bot was released to promote the release of Astro Bot.
Characters from God of War appear in the Secret Level episode "Playtime: Fulfillment".
Characters from God of War appear in the "Secret Lair x God of War" releases for Magic: The Gathering.

Music from Goddess of Victory: NIKKE can be found in Chunithm as part of a special collaboration.

Characters from Evangelion appear in Goddess of Victory: NIKKE as part of a special collaboration.

Jill Valentine, Ada Wong, and Claire Redfield from Resident Evil appear in Goddess of Victory: NIKKE as part of a collaboration event.

Popeye is mentioned by Kazuo in King Kong vs.. Godzilla.
Godzilla and Mothra have appeared in many films and media together.
Rodan would become a recurring character in the Godzilla series.
Manda from Atragon appears in the Godzilla film Destroy All Monsters, and appears in other Godzilla media.
Godzilla and Gamera fought during the stage show Godzilla vs.. Gamera.

Godzilla, Gigan, and King Ghidorah all made appearances in a few episodes of Zone Fighter.

the Fantastic Four appear in Godzilla: King of the Monsters #20, #21, #22, #23 and #24. Additionally, Godzilla vs. Fantastic Four is a crossover between the two series.

Godzilla makes many appearances in the Dr. Slump manga.
Posters of Godzilla appear in Friday the 13th Part III.

Godzilla can be seen on a news broadcast in Airplane II: The Sequel.
The monster Dodzilla from Time Gal is based on Godzilla.
Godzilla is mentioned in part 2 of the comic story Time Bomb from issue 115 of Doctor Who Magazine.

The monster Lizzie seems to be a parody of Godzilla.
Rodan statues and a small Godzilla appear in the NES game Circus Caper.
Godzilla is parodied in Adolescent Radioactive Black Belt Hamsters Massacre The Japanese Invasion.
Many Godzilla References are in Mario.
A creature resembling Godzilla is a boss in early versions of Revenge Of Shinobi.
Several films in the Godzilla series are featured in Mystery Science Theater 3000.
Godzilla is mentioned in the Dinosaurs episode "Hurling Day".
Godzilla appears in Battle Soccer: Field no Hasha.
Hello Kitty appears in the amusement park event Monster Planet of Godzilla.
One of Lawrence Knowles's nicknames is "Godzilla".
Secret of Evermore features a reference to Godzilla.
The episode "The Big Sister" features a reference to Godzilla.
Godzilla is mentioned in Jack.
The martians watch Godzilla vs. Biollante in Mars Attacks.
Godzilla toys are shown in Armageddon.

Godzilla.game: The Secret Files of the Spy Dogs
Godzilla.description: The character Porkzilla is a parody of Godzilla.
A sketch of Godzilla can be seen on the Magna Doodle in the Friends episode: "The One with the Apothecary Table".

In Sing a Song of Patrick, one of the comics in Near Mint Comic Books contains an image of a creature that looks similar to Godzilla.

Goofy.description: The Goofy series is a spin-off of the Mickey Mouse series; Mickey also makes an appearance in the Donald and Goofy short The Fox Hunt and in A Goofy Movie; Goofy's nephew Gilbert then makes an appearace in a Mickey Mouse sunday page from May 30, 1954 and in some other stories, while Goofy's son Max from Goof Troop is featured in Mickey's Once Upon a Christmas and the House of Mouse series; The Mickey, Donald and Goofy cartoons in Mickey Mouse Works can be considered crossovers between the two series; the Mickey Mouse episode "Good Sports" is based on the Goofy sports shorts.

The Donald and Goofy shorts as well as The Mickey, Donald and Goofy cartoons in Mickey Mouse Works and the movie Mickey, Donald, Goofy: The Three Musketeers can be considered crossovers between the two series;Humphrey the Bear from the Goofy short Hold That Pose makes an appearance in the Donald Duck short Rugged Bear and then becomes a regular character in the series.

Gradius.description: The Vic Viper from Gradius appears as a collectible in The Goonies'.
Salamander is a spinoff of Gradius.
TwinBee makes a cameo appearance in the MSX version of Gradius.

Moai heads and the Vic Viper from the Gradius series appear as items in several Castlevania games, while the boss Bat Company from Dawn of Sorrow can assume the form of the giant Moai boss from Gradius.
Penta from Antarctic Adventure is a hidden character in Nemesis 2.
Moai and the Vic Viper from Gradius are playable in Konami Wai Wai World.
Parodius is a spin-off of Gradius.
A Moai mask from Gradius can be bought at the Joy Division store in all versions of Snatcher.
A Moai and Dr. Venom from Gradius are opponents in Hai no Majutsushi.

Goemon visits the world of Gradius in the Ganbare Goemon: Jigenjou no Akumu OVA. The first level of Arcade Gradius can be played at the Amusement Park in Legend of the Mystical Ninja. Ganbare Goemon 2 features a miniature Big Core Mk.II and an holographic, samurai-themed Moai as bosses, and there are references to Gradius in the credits of Ganbare Goemon: Uchuu Kaizoku Akogingu.
A Moai from Gradius makes a cameo appearance in Hexion.
Moai and Ducker from Gradius appear in Monster Maulers.
The boss "Pulsating Plasma Blaster" from Rocket Knight Adventuresis based on bosses from Gradius; the flying sections in the game also pay homage to the series.
Advertisements for Gradius can be found in Midnight Run: Road Fighter 2.
Two wrestlers in Jikkyō Power Pro Wrestling '96: Max Voltage are inspired in Gradius, one named "Big the Moai" after the Moai and the other "El Gradius".
Vic Viper from Gradius is a secret playable character in Neo Kobe 2045 Speed King.
Gradius is included in Konami GB Collection Vol. 1, while Gradius II is included in Vol. 3.
One stage in GUNbare! Game Tengoku 2 features a boss parody of the Big Core from Gradius.
Metal Gear Solid and Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of the Patriots feature the Moai from Gradius as a secret Easter egg.
Stickers of Vic Viper and the Moai head from Gradius can be seen in printstations from Mitsumete Knight R.
There's an entire series of Yu-Gi-Oh cards based around characters and items from Gradius.
Konami Krazy Racers features the Moai and Vic Viper from Gradius as selectable racers.
The Vic Viper from Gradius is playable in Airforce Delta Storm and Airforce Delta Strike.
The Vic Viper that Leo pilots in Zone of the Enders: The 2nd Runner is a variant of the Vic Viper from Gradius. The 2nd Runner also contains a parody of Gradius called Zoradius.
Characters and tracks from Gradius appear throughout the Pop'n Music series.
A model Vic Viper can be seen in Frogger's Journey.
Moai from Gradius is selectable in DreamMix TV World Fighters.
Arino plays the NES port of Gradius in episode 9. He did a full challenge in episode 136.
La-Mulana features a collectible rom for Gradius, Gradius 2, and Nemesis 3..
The Vic Viper appears in I Wanna Be The Guy.
Otomedius is a spin-off of Gradius.
A weapon used in two Challenge missions from Contra 4 shoots miniature Vic Vipers. Contra ReBirth features several references to the Gradius series.
The Japanese version of Scribblenauts features the Vic Viper from Gradius as a spawnable object.
A dragon version of the Vic Viper from Gradius appears as a boss in Monster Retsuden Oreca Battle.
One of Peacock's attacks and one of Double's Blockbusters in Skullgirls references the Moai Head from Gradius.
Josuke was playing a parody of Gradius in Episode 11 of Diamond is Unbreakable.

A DLC Bomberman from Super Bomberman R (added in Ver.1.4) known as "Vic Viper Bomber" is based off the Vic Viper ship from Gradius, while Ver.2.0 update added "Option Bomber", based on the series' Option power-up.
There's a minor reference to Gradius in episode 3 of Pop Team Epic.
Gunpei was playing a parody of Gradius in the second OVA of Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan.
"Gradius" is one themed category of puzzles featured in Pixel Puzzle Collection.
The "Konami 50th Anniversary Wai Wai Collab" limited event from Bombergirl features a Gradius BGM.
Vic Viper, Golem and Moai from Gradius make appearances in Kaettekita Pixel Crows.
Gradius can be seen in Animation vs. Super Mario Bros.

Gravity Falls.description: Bat Boy is referenced in the intro of Gravity Falls.
In the episode Tourist Trapped, Stan wears a Gill-man mask to scare Dipper. The Gill-man is from the 1954 film, Creature from the Black Lagoon.

In the Gravity Falls episode Tourist Trapped, the way Mabel takes the grappling hook out of the box and spins around is a reference to The Legend of Zelda. The Gravity Falls episode "Dungeons, Dungeons, and More Dungeons" features a reference to Navi from The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.
The Gravity Falls episode Headhunters parodies The Twilight Zone episode The New Exhibit.
2319 from Monsters Inc. was referenced in the episode Headhunters by Officer Blubs as 2316.
In The Hand That Rocks the Mabel, while watching Gideon's commercial on TV, Mabel makes the same noise Scooby-Doo makes when questioning something.
There are several references to Twin Peaks in Gravity Falls.
The Gravity Falls episodes "The Inconveniencing" and "Fight Fighters" feature videogames based on Dance Dance Revolution.

In Dipper vs. Manliness, one of the scenes in the training montage shows Dipper having his eyes held open by the Manotaurs and being shown inspirational posters, which is a reference to the Ludovico technique from A Clockwork Orange.
On Dipper's list from Double Dipper, steps 19 and 20 reference his knowledge of "Monstermon," a reference to Pokémon. A Ash Ketchum version of Mabel appears in Gravity Falls: Lost Legends.
In Irrational Treasure, Quentin Trembley rides his horse backwards, much like Dudley Do-Right from Rocky & Bullwinkle.
In The Time Traveler's Pig, Mabel and Waddles eating the same slice of pizza from different ends references a scene from Lady and the Tramp.
The Gravity Falls episode "Fight Fighters" feature references to the Mario series.
The Gravity Falls episode "Fight Fighters" feature references to Donkey Kong.
The titular video game in the Gravity Falls episode "Fight Fighters" is based on Street Fighter II.
The Gravity Falls episode "Fight Fighters" features a reference to Mortal Kombat.
The Gravity Falls episode "Fight Fighters" features a fictional game based on Pac-Man. Pac-Mabel, a Pac-Man version of Mabel, appears in Gravity Falls: Lost Legends.
The Gravity Falls episode "Fight Fighters" features a fictional videogame based on Frogger.
In Little Dipper, Mabel shouts "Expecto Wizarium," a reference to "Expecto Patronum," a spell from Harry Potter.

In the episode Summerween from Gravity Falls, one of the pictures has the caption "i hate mondais," a reference to Garfield. In Gravity Falls: Lost Legends, there is a parody of Garfield called Sarcasti-Pup who hates Tuesdays.
Dipper and Mabel are racers in Disney Super Speedway.
In My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic comic issue #5, a pony named "Maybelle" appears in Rarity's nightmares, with a brown mane, pink sweater and a shooting star cutie mark.
A character is dressed up as the Goblin King in Mabel's Guide To Fashion.
A girl resembling Mabel appears in "Fun Dead". Matt's face briefly transforms into Bill Cipher in "Beaster Bunny".
An advertisement in Poptropica for Disney XD Animacation has some cardboard cutouts of some Gravity Falls characters.
Characters from  Gravity Falls appear in Disney XD Villains Unite!.
The Eye of Sauron appears in the episode "Little Gift Shop of Horrors".

In the Gravity Falls episode "Society of the Blind Eye", Stan loses a coffee mug, notepad, and pen which flies into portal. Those are the same items that came out of a portal in the Rick and Morty episode "Close Rick-counters of the Rick Kind". Bill Cipher appears on a monitor in the Rick and Morty episode "Big Trouble in Little Sanchez". In the Rick and Morty episode "The Rickshank Rickdemption", two Mortys can be seen dressed like Dipper and Mabel from Gravity Falls. The creator of Gravity Falls (Alex Hirsch) has also confirmed that the two shows take place in the same universe.
Characters from Gravity Falls appears in Disney Infinity 2.0.
In Journal 3 and the episode "Northwest Mansion Mystery", there is a parody of Freddy Krueger known as a "Dream Hipster" who could "turn Power Naps into Horror Naps".
In a limited-time event in Roblox, players could get Dipper's hat. The description says that this was actually borrowed from Dipper himself.
A replica of Dipper's hat makes a cameo in "Rain on Your Charade".
The Gravity Falls episode: "The Last Mabelcorn"'s title is an allusion to The Last Unicorn.
Two characters resembling Dipper and Mabel Pines from Gravity Falls appear in "Little Witch Academia: The Enchanted Parade".
A promotional video released in 2015 for Doctor Who's arrival on Disney XD featured the TARDIS entering the Mystery Shack, as seen by Dipper, Mabel, and Grunkle Stan.
A code in Gravity Falls: Journal 3 refrences the quote "Can I keep you?" from the film Casper

There are frogs in Amphibia that resemble Stan and Soos from Gravity Falls.  Frog Soos also mentions the concept of multiple parallel universes. Additionally, a Gideon Gleeful plush toy is seen in the background of Amphibia's opening during season 3. Darcey's helmet can be found in The Book of Bill.  A figurine of Stan Pines can be found on the shelf in the garage in "Fixing Frobo".

In the Gravity Falls episode "Bottomless Pit!", Dipper saying "How you diddly-doing, Soos?" is a reference to how Ned Flanders from The Simpsons talks. Bill Cipher appears in the Simpsons episode "Bart's In Jail!".

In a tweet, Phineas and Ferb creator Dan Povenmire would suggest this to merely be a coincidence, but was admittedly uncertain.

Jeremy buys Half Life 2 in the Pure Pwnage episode "Pwn Or Be Pwned".

A copy of 1984 can be found amongst garbage in Half-Life 2 (contained in the texture "Garbage001a 01 1984".) 1984 is the inspiration behind multiple elements of Half-Life 2 and is referenced throughout the game.
Characters from Half-Life 2 star in the "So Cold" video of Video Mods.
In Asterix & Obelix XXL 2: Mission: Las Vegum there are Half-Life references.

Halo.description: The Red vs. Blue series is a parody of the Halo series. Grifball, a fictional sport that originated in Red vs. Blue, was developed into an official weekly playlist for Halo 3, and would go on to be included in every subsequent Halo game after Halo: Reach. Additionally, Master Chief appears in "Red Vs Blue Prepare for Master Chiefs Arrival".
Francis in Spy Kids 3-D: Game Over said there is no lava in Halo.
Master Chief from Halo is mentioned in Doogal.
The wardens in The Longest Yard are seen playing Halo 2.
In Conker: Celebrity Squirrel, gameplay footage of Halo 2 was shown with Conker voicing Master Chief.
Halo is mentioned in 40 Year Old Virgin.
Halo is mentioned in the English dub of the 5th episode of Ghost Stories.
The character SPARTAN-458 in Dead or Alive 4 is a SPARTAN-II supersoldier from the Halo series; her stage, called Nassau Station, is also from the series.
In Halo 3 there is an armor called the "Hayabusa Powered Assault Armor" named after Ryu Hyabusa from "Ninja Gaiden".
Halo is referenced in many episodes of The Big Bang Theory.
The song "Halo Theme MJOLNIR Mix" from Halo 2 was featured in Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock as free DLC for Xbox 360 users.
Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts features a reference to the Halo series.
Risk: Halo Wars Collector’s Edition is a format crossover between the two.
A set of four Halo characters were made into Piñata Vision cards and respective piñatas in Viva Piñata: Trouble in Paradise.
In Night at the Museum 2: Battle of the Smithsonian, Nicky owns a Spartan figure.
The Big Bang Theory episode "The Bozeman Reaction" features a reference to the Halo games.
Ian and Anthony set out to buy Halo 2 in HALO RUINED MY LIFE!.
InFamous 2 features a reference to Halo in a movie title and a mission's name.

In Duke Nukem Forever, Duke is offered a power armor identical to Master Chief's, but Duke refuses saying "Power Armor is for pussies"; the helmet from the armor is one of three collectable helmets in the game and the DLC map "Sandbox" is inspired by the Halo: Combat Evolved map "Bloody Gulch".
Sticky grenade is a homage to the plasma grenades from the Halo.
Master Chief has been a subject for Death Battle!
Master Chief has been a rapper for Epic Rap Battles of History.
A Master Chief toy appears in "Ask Orange #4: Master Chef".
Master Chief's suit appears in Clássicos do Cinema - Turma da Mônica #32.

The Minecraft Legacy Console and Bedrock Editions feature three downloadable skins based on Halo characters in Skin Pack 1, two more in Skin Pack 4 exclusive to the Xbox 360 and Xbox One Editions, three in the Minecraft 2nd Birthday Skin Pack, as well as a full Halo-themed mash-up pack.
Mason and Randy play Halo: Combat Evolved in Boyhood.
Destiny features a reference to Halo as a building is shape similiar to the iconic helmet of Master Chief.
The Video Game High School episode "Nobody Cool Goes To Prom" features a game called "Naked Halo", while the episode "Being A Teen Is Hard, I Guess" features a reference to Master Chief.
A team consisting of characters from Halo appears in #IDARB.
Phil plays Halo: The Master Chief Collection in the Modern Family episode: "Connection Lost".
Halo characters are parodied in Console Wars.
A person is dressed up as Master Chief from Halo in Ted 2.
Benji can be seen playing Halo 5 in Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation.
Dino Run DX features a hat based on Master Chief.
Monopoly: Halo Collector's Edition is a format crossover between the two series.
The "HogSticker" car exclusive of the Xbox One version of Rocket League is officially an alternate Warthog from the Halo series.
Arbiter from Halo is a DLC character in Season 3 of Killer Instinct.
Master Chief has been a subject for DBX.

The 2554 AMG Transport Dynamics M12S Warthog CST from Halo is featured in Forza Horizon 3 and Forza Horizon 4. Initially available to anyone who played either Halo: The Master Chief Collection or Halo 5: Guardians between September 6, 2016 and September 23, 2016, the M12S Warthog CST has been featured in several Forzathon events in Forza Horizon 3.
After ejecting from your Titan, there is a 15% chance of getting the message "FINISH THE FIGHT.", a reference to Halo.
Geometry Dash features a robot skin based on Master Chief.

A Bomberman exclusive to the Xbox One version of Super Bomberman R known as "Master Chief Bomber" is based off the main character from Halo, while Ver.2.2 added two more bombermen, "Arbiter Bomber" and "Grunt Bomber", based off Halo characters.
Halo is parodied in multiple Perfect Cell Vs episodes.
Gears 5 features a Halo: Reach character pack.
In Neon Abyss, the Kinetic Blade and Virtual Assistant Items are references to Halo.
Master Chief and a UNSC Spartan from Halo appear in Fortnite.
The energy sword from Halo appears in the Airship map in Among Us. A set of Spartan armor and Guilty Spark pet are avaliable for the Xbox and Microsoft Store versions or Among Us.
An Energy Sword from Halo can be found on display in a training hall in Nobody Saves the World.
Needy Streamy Overload feaures a parody video game that features elements of Halo.
A Pelican from Halo Infinite appears in the 2020 version of Microsoft Flight Simulator as a free add-on.
A skin based on Master Chief, a Brute and a Grunt from Halo appear in Fall Guys.
Master Chief and the Arbiter appear as playable characters in Brawlhalla.
The Spartan 117 armor from Halo appears as a skin for Sledge in Rainbow Six: Siege, along with several other cosmetics based on Halo.
A UNSC poster and Master Chief statue can be seen in the MeatCanyon episode "Tragedy Of A Reaction Streamer".
Halo memorabilia can be seen in the Melvins Macabre episode "NOSTALGIA".
Weapons and cosmetics based on Halo: ODST were added to Helldivers 2 as part of an update.

Happy Feet, Cats & Dogs: Revenge of Kitty Galore and Yogi Bear have been released on DVD together.

In the Series 3 episode "The Shakespeare Code", there are several references to the Harry Potter franchise. At one point, Martha says "It's all a bit Harry Potter", which prompts the Doctor to claim that he has read the final book in the series (which would not be released until three months after the episode was aired; the Doctor refers to it as "Book 7" because the title had not been made public at the time of filming). At the end of the episode, Shakespeare, the Doctor and Martha use a word from Harry Potter, "Expelliarmus", to defeat the Carrionites, and the Doctor exclaims "Good old J.K.!".

Hatsune Miku.description: Hatsune Miku is a spinoff of the Vocaloid series.

Miku's Leek is an unlockable weapon in Phantasy Star 0. A costume for Luka based on Nagisa Adelheid Howzer from Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity can be obtained in Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Extend, while a costume for Miku based on the Force-type outfits worn by female Newmans in Phantasy Star Online 2 can be obtained in Project DIVA F; a cover of the theme song of Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity, "Ignite Infinity", is also included in the album Hatsune Miku -Project DIVA- extend Special Collaboration Album VOCALOID extend REMIXIES.

A costume based on Alicia Melchiott from Valkyria Chronicles can be obtained in Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA, while costumes based on Imca and Kurt Irving from Valkyria Chronicles III can be obtained in Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Extend and Arcade; a cover of the opening theme song of Valkyria Chronicles III, "If You Wish For...", is also included in the album Hatsune Miku -Project DIVA- extend Special Collaboration Album VOCALOID extend REMIXIES.
A remix of "Magical Sound Shower" from OutRun appears in Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Arcade and several subsequent Project DIVA games.

Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA 2nd features a Sarah Bryant costume for Megurine Luka, while Project DIVA Extend features a Kage-Maru costume for KAITO; a Virtua Fighter 2 arcade machine appears as a decoration in Hatsune Miku: Project Mirai DX.

Henry Stickmin.description: In Breaking the Bank, the conversation between Chad Hansen and Philly Colin is a reference to Red vs Blue.

In Escaping The Prison when the option to go left is selected Henry trips is a reference to how characters in Smash Bros Brawl may randomly trip, several reference to Captain Falcon's moveset can be found in later games.

The "Lawyered Up" path in Escaping the Prison includes a spoof of the Ace Attorney series' trial scene gameplay, with a stick figure Phoenix Wright (later renamed Felix White to avoid copyright issues) serving as counsel.
Fletcher Reede's name from Liar Liar can be seen on Henry's cellphone in Escaping the Prison.
Hyper Chicken's name from Futurama can be seen on Henry's cellphone in Escaping the Prison.
The way Henry uses a drill in Escaping the Prison is a direct reference to Mr. Driller.
The bullet time scene from The Matrix is spoofed in Escaping the Prison.
Sound effects from Worms are used in Escaping The Prison, a Banana Bomb appears in Infiltrating the Airship.
Stealing the Diamond features a reference to Banjo-Kazooie, while the Clawpack used in Infiltrating the Airship is similar to Kazooie from Banjo-Kazooie.

A painting of Luigi from Mario can be found in Stealing the Diamond, Judge Planta's name from Super Mario Sunshine can be seen in Henry's cellphone in the remastered version of Escaping the Prison; while a Super Mushroom and Spiny Shell appear in Stealing the Diamond, a Koopa Shell in Infiltrating the Airship, the Bounce Bros attack from Mario and Luigi: Superstar Saga, Mario's Super Jump and the Leaf/Tanooki item appear as options in Fleeing the Complex, and the characters Marty O. and Louie G. are based on Mario and Luigi and perform the "Do the Mario" dance.

A painting of Harkinian can be found in Stealing the Diamond, a spoof of the chest opening cutscenes from Ocarina of Time appears in Infiltrating the Airship, a spoof of the melody gameplay in Wind Waker and the series' Longshot appear in Fleeing the Complex; and the ocarina from Ocarina of Time, the Moon from Majora's Mask and the stamina and inventory of Breath of the Wild appear in Completing the Mission.
A painting resembling Leonidas from 300 can be found in Stealing the Diamond, while minor references appear in Completing the Mission.
The Portal Gun (later renamed "Wormhole Gun" to avoid copyright issues) is used in Stealing the Diamond.

A creeper appears in Stealing the Diamond as well as a spoof of how walls are mined in-game. The remastered version of Breaking the Bank features a reference to Minecraft. A second spoof is featured in Completing the Mission.

When Henry gets close to a crowbar in Stealing The Diamond headcrabs fall on him, there's a Gravity Gun (later redesigned into the "Gravity Manipulator" to avoid copyright issues) option in Infiltrating the Airship and several more references in Completing the Mission.
The theme music of CSI Miami can be heard on an off-screen tv in Stealing the Diamond.
A water bubble from Sonic is used in Stealing the Diamond, a robot resembling Tails appears in Infiltrating the Airship and Sonic's red shoes appear as an option in Fleeing the Complex.
A Metroid (later turned into a generic alien to avoid copyright issues) appears in Stealing the Diamond.

A snipe shooter says "Ah, piss" referencing the sniper from  Team Fortress 2 in Stealing the Diamond, the character Jaque LeTouch from Infiltrating the Airship is based on the Spy class and Completing the Mission includes several more references to the game.

A pokeball (later renamed "Goodball" to avoid copyright issues) can be found in Stealing the Diamond in a scene spoofing Pokémon battles from the series; Completing the Mission includes spoofs of the Z-Move from Pokémon Sun & Moon and the Agility move.
The sticky grenade in Stealing the Diamond is a homage to the plasma grenades from Halo.
Stars of the wanted level indicator from GTA appear in Stealing the Diamond, and the Wasted screen appears in Fleeing the Complex.
Henry plays a game similar to Civilization V in Infiltrating the Airship.
The use of Zero-Point Energy in Infiltrating the Airship is a reference to The Incredibles.
The power grid seen in Infiltrating the Airship is a reference to Mass Effect.
A bomb used by Henry in Infiltrating the Airship is based on those used by Bomberman.
The "Wizard Magic" choice in Infiltrating the Airship is a spoof on Dungeons & Dragons.
The armor used in one path from Infiltrating the Airship is based on the T-45 power armor from Fallout, the sniper HUD is referenced in Completing the Mission.
The use of Metal Bend and Earthbend in Infiltrating the Airship and Fleeing the Complex are references to Avatar: The Last Airbender.
There's a minor reference to Harry Potter in Infiltrating the Airship.
There's a minor reference to Gandalf in Infiltrating the Airship.
The Techno Trousers (later renamed "Robo Pants" to avoid copyright issues) appears in Infiltrating the Airship.
There's a spoof of the battle system from EarthBound in Infiltrating the Airship.
There's a spoof of the battle system from Final Fantasy VI in Infiltrating the Airship, Cloud's Buster Sword appears in Completing the Mission.
Stick figures of Ryu and Ken (later named Rai U. and Kent) appear in Infiltrating the Airship.
One of the fail messages in Infiltrating the Airship says "Come on and SLAM, and welcome to the JAM!".
There's a minor reference to Spy Kids in Infiltrating the Airship.
There are minor references to SpongeBob in Infiltrating the Airship and later games.
Hank Hill is mentioned in one of the fail messages from Infiltrating the Airship.
The character Isaac Binderson from Fleeing the Complex is inspired by The Binding of Isaac.
Isaac's spear from Fleeing the Complex is based on the Ma'Tok staff from Stargate SG-1.
The Tool Gun from Garry's Mod appears in Fleeing the Complex.
The character Heath Stone in Fleeing the Complex is named after Hearthstone, and she speaks about the game.
The use of the Force in Fleeing the Complex and Completing the Mission are references to Star Wars.
There are minor references to Call of Duty in Fleeing the Complex and Completing the Mission.
The box option in Fleeing the Complex is a spoof of the Metal Gear item, while the "Master Bounty Hunter" route in Completing the Mission features several references to the series.
The sandwich option in Fleeing the Complex is a spoof of the Castle Crashers item.
Spider-Man's web throw appears as an option in Fleeing the Complex, there are two references to the first Spider-Man movie trilogy in Completing the Mission.
Kirby's Warp Star appears as an option in Fleeing the Complex.
There's a spoof of the battle system from Advance Wars in Fleeing the Complex.
There's a spoof of the battle system from Fire Emblem in Fleeing the Complex.
Freddy Fazbear appears in Fleeing the Complex.
The Slingshot option in Fleeing the Complex is a reference to Angry Birds.

The diamond and teleporter from Henry Stickmin can be found in Among Us, there's a poster for The Henry Stickmin Collection in the MIRA HQ map, Henry and Ellie Rose appear as selectable pets and several cosmetics are taken from Henry Stickmin characters; the Henry Stickmin Collection includes sound effects from Among Us and crewmember plushies as collectables, a reference to its expelled screen and minor nods; a later update to Among Us adds a map based on the Airship from Infiltrating the Airship.
Saul Goodman's name from Breaking Bad can be seen on Henry's cellphone in the remastered version of Escaping the Prison.
The Nintendo 64 cartridge Conker's Bad Fur Day can be seen in one of the endings from Completing the Mission.
In the "Special BROvert Ops" route from Completing the Mission, Charles broadcasts an episode of Seinfeld as a distraction.
The "Triple Threat" route in Completing the Mission includes several references to Dragon Ball, mainly to its Fusion Dance.
The "Dance Moves" emote from Fortnite appears in Completing the Mission. The Distraction Dance from Fleeing the Complex appears in Fortnite as an emote.
The Mind Crystal is a reference to the Plumbob.
The "Revenged" route in Completing the Mission includes several references to JoJo's Bizarre Adventure and its use of Stands, another scene references the Torture Dance from Part 5.
There's a spoof of the battle system from Undertale in Completing the Mission.
One of the options in Completing the Mission spoof the gameplay of Star Fox.
One scene from Completing the Mission uses the cannon barrels from the Donkey Kong Country series, another references the Donkey Kong 64 Rap.
The character Timothy Turner from Completing the Mission is inspired by Timmy Turner from The Fairly OddParents.
The character Jonathan Bravo from Completing the Mission is inspired by Johnny Bravo.
The character Bort Sampson from Completing the Mission is inspired by Bart Simpson from The Simpsons.
The character Hat Girl from Completing the Mission is inspired by Hat Kid from A Hat in Time.
The character Nacy Popo from Completing the Mission is inspired by the Ice Climbers.
There are minor references to Mortal Kombat in Completing the Mission.
There's a minor reference to Assassin's Creed in Completing the Mission.
There's a minor reference to Starcraft 2 in Completing the Mission.
There's a minor reference to Avengers: Infinity War in Completing the Mission.

IT (Stephen King).description: Castle Rock from The Stand appears in IT.
The Town of Jerusalem's Lot appears in IT.
The town "Gatlin" from Children of the Corn was mentioned in It.
Mt. Hope Cemetery appears in both Pet Sematary and IT; a sign for Derry, the fictional town IT takes place in, can be seen in the 2019 Pet Sematary film.
Frank Dodd from The Dead Zone is mentioned in IT.
Derry, Maine from The Bird and the Album appears in IT.
The Shawshank Prison appears in IT. A Shawshank Prison bus appears in IT: Welcome to Derry.
Mrs. Kaspbrak from IT is mentioned in Misery.
Stephen King's novel The Tommyknockers, IT is viewed as a supposed hallucination when one of the "becoming" goes to Derry to stock up on supplies.
Nan's Luncheonette from IT appears in The Dark Half.
The Juniper Hill Asylum from IT appears in Gerald's Game.
In Dollhouse Drama, while Dexter's hallucinating the "ghost of his first love", the hand puppet Dee Dee wears is a reference to the horrific clown Pennywise.
Maturin The Turtle from It appears in The Dark Tower IV: Wizard and Glass.
Stewie sees an evil looking clown at a game stand and comments that “it looks like something out of Stephen King.”

There is a scene in the Scrubs episode "His Story II" where Turk imagines Carla talking to him through a mail slot that parodies the scene from It where Pennywise talks to Georgie through a sewer drain.
The Nostalgia Critic reviews "IT".
Characters from It appears in 11/22/63.

In the episode No One Can Hear You, the fact that Stag's lair is down in the sewer (where he meets his demise), the imagery of the balloons Jake wears, and the haunting snippets of carnival music that play are references to It.
In NOS4A2, the FBI tries to use a cell phone map to track Wayne's cell phone; the map includes the town of Derry, Maine, and a place called "Pennywise's Circus" from IT.
The fifth episode of Life Is Strange features a reference to It.
The character That is influenced by Pennywise.
The Pennywise the Koala is a reference to It.
Richie Tozier plays Street Fighter in It and It: Chapter Two.
Pennywise's hair appears in the shop.
It was mentioned in the South Park episode “Splatty Tomatoes”.
IT is mentioned in the Big Bang Theory episode “The Tesla Recoil”.
Pitch Meeting had episodes on the IT movies.
Nan's Luncheonette from IT appears in Castle Rock.
There is a red balloon in the film Goosebumps 2 referencing It.
In Fortnite, red balloons could be found next to the drainage channels and near the sidewalks of Pleasant Park. Popping these balloons would emit Pennywise's laugh.
Mr. Peterson's clown costume in Secret Neighbor is a reference to Pennywise from IT (1990).
IT is parodied in Clássicos do Cinema - Turma da Mônica #66. Pennywise appears in said issue.
There is a poster of the movie IT in Ice Scream..
Clue: IT is a format crossover between the two series.
Monopoly: IT is a format crossover between the two series.
Skullector is a Monster High collaborative toy line that has featured Pennywise from IT.
Nickelwise in the segment “Fear and Laughter in Burbank” is a parody on Pennywise from Stephen King’s IT.
Pennywise appears in Space Jam: A New Legacy.
Master Detective Archives: RAIN CODE features a reference to Pennywise.
Pennywise Clown Skibidi Toilet is based on Pennywise from IT.
IT is parodied in the MeatCanyon episode "David Dobrik's New Body".

Ice Age.description: The stage "Ice Edge" from Viewtiful Joe 2 is named after the Ice Age film series.
A robot version of Sid from Ice Age appears in Robots.
The mammoth, saber-toothed tiger, and saber-toothed squirrel from the episode Retro are references to Manny, Diego and Scrat from Ice Age.

Advertisements for Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs and Ice Age: Continental Drift are in Poptropica, which allow the player to meet some of the characters.
Footage from Ice Age appears in Kaku Spring Festival Gala 2010.
Ice Age shows on tv in Diary Of A Wimpy Kid.

Independence Day is referenced in The League of Extraordinary Gentlemen Vol. 2 #6.
Independence Day is mentioned in the Joey episode: "Joey and the Premiere".
David Levinson from Independence Day appears in "How to Survive an Alien Attack".
The twenty-nineth episode of The Angry Video Game Nerd is a review of the PlayStation game Independence Day.
Independence Day DVD is shown in Be Kind Rewind.
A Harvester appears in Clássicos do Cinema - Turma da Mônica #35. A City destroyer appears in Clássicos do Cinema - Turma da Mônica #41.
Independence Day is mentioned in "TOBUSCUS ANIMATED ADVENTURES #8 - WORLD WAR PvZ".

The skull of a Harvester from Independence Day appears in Predator: Badlands.

Indiana Jones.description: A Yar from Yars' Revenge makes a cameo in the game Raiders of the Lost Ark for Atari 2600.
Indiana Jones makes a cameo in the game E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial for Atari 2600. E.T. appears as one of the tiles in Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull.
There are several references to Indiana Jones in Tower of Babel.
An Indiana Jones And The Temple Of Doom poster is shown in Video Violence.
The Italian Mickey Mouse character Indiana Pipps (Arizona Goof) is based on Indiana Jones, with his debut story "Topolino & Pippo in: I predatori del tempio perduto" based on Raiders of the Lost Ark.
The shuttlecraft Indiana Jones is shown on Star Trek: The Next Generation "Evolution"

The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3 episode "Misadventure of Mighty Plumber" mentions Indiana Jones in the Latin American Spanish dub and Castilian Spanish re-dub. The Super Mario Bros. Super Show! episode "Raiders of the Lost Mushroom" is a parody of Raiders of the Lost Ark.

The Sam & Max: Freelance Police story on issue 3 of The Adventurer is a parody of Indiana Jones and the Fate of Atlantis and there also are references to Indiana Jones movies in Sam & Max Hit the Road.
The Indiana Jones universe is one of the worlds visited.

Homer is burned inside an Ark that is resemblant of the Ark of the Covenant from Raiders Of The Lost Ark in the episode "Homer the Great".  A skeletal hand is also seen reaching for Jones's trademark fedora in The Simpsons Game.
In Duke Nukem 3D, a corpse similar to Indiana Jones and a trap that pays homage to Raiders Of The Lost Ark can be found in Episode 4, Level 8. Upon finding it, Duke quips "We meet again, Dr. Jones".
You can find a treasure in Kirby Super Star called the "Indy Whip" in Japan. Additionally, the Whip Copy Ability is based on Indiana Jones.

La Planète Donkey Kong features an episode titled "Raiders of the Lost Banana", referncing Raiders of the Lost Ark. The German website for Donkey Kong 64 lists Diddy Kong's favorite movie as being "Banana Jones 2", referencing Indiana Jones.

Indiana Jones and Star Wars crossover with each other various times. First one being Indiana Jones making a cameo in the game Star Wars: Yoda Stories. Also, C-3PO's head appears in Lego Indiana Jones while Han Solo frozen in carbonite is in the sequel.  Indiana Jones and a trailer for LEGO Indiana Jones: The Original Adventures are unlockable in LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga and LEGO Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Out includes references to Indiana Jones. Also, Star Wars characters are unlockable in Lego Indiana Jones while Han Solo appears frozen in carbonite is in the sequel. An exclusive set was also released that featured both Indiana Jones and Han Solo called "Han Solo/Indiana Jones Transformation Chamber"

Indiana Jones briefly enters the Monkey Island universe in the game Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine; additionally Guybrush briefly turns into Indy in the demo version of The Secret of Monkey Island and there's a book written by "I. Jones" in Monkey Island 2.
Johnny Thunder was cited as being heavily inspired by Indiana Jones.
There are many references to Raiders of the Lost Ark throughout the Happy Tree Friends series.
In the "What if?" mode from the Spider-Man 2000 video game, the Ark of the Covenant from Raiders of the Lost Ark appears as an Easter Egg.
In Conker's Bad Fur Day there are references to the films Raiders of the Lost Ark and Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade.

In the Omalen Ancestral Tomb, a skeleton can be found seemingly crushed under a rock, grasping for a ruby. It's identity is revealed after reading his supposed journal, titled A Dying Man's Last Words which is from "Indie".
Indiana Jones is mentioned in the Friends episode: "The One with the Cooking Class".
An idol resembling the Golden Idol from Indiana Jones appears in  Spy Kids 2: The Island of Lost Dreams.
Raiders of the Lost Ark is parodied in the Malcolm in the Middle episode: "Stereo Store".
Characters recreate a scene from Indiana Jones in the Cartoon Monsoon pilot Oh, Shoot!
A poster of Raiders of the Lost Ark is shown in the 2004 comedy film Mean Girls.
Indiana Jones is mentioned in the Joey episode: "Pilot".
The stage "Viewtiful Heroes and the Statue of Doom" from Viewtiful Joe 2 is named after Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom.
Indiana Jones is parodied in the Robot Chicken episode "Plastic Buffet".
The VeggieTales episode "Minnesota Cuke And The Search For Samson's Hairbrush" is a parody of Indiana Jones.
A movie theater plays Raiders of the Lost Ark in the 2005 film Chicken Little.
Indiana Jones is mentioned in Snakes On A Plane
The Fedora item from Portrait of Ruin and Harmony of Despair is a reference to Indiana Jones.
In Tomb Raider Anniversary you can find the boulder and if you dodge it at look closely at the boulder there's a smashed fedora and whip showing that The Boulder killed Indiana Jones this time.
The Irate Gamer reviews Indiana Jones & The Temple of Doom on NES.

King Kong appears in Space Jam: A New Legacy.
Kong appears in Funko Pop! Blitz.

Justice League vs. Godzilla vs. Kong is a crossover between the three series.

King Kong has been a rapper for Epic Rap Battles of History.
Characters from Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire appeared in Lords Mobile as part of a special collaboration.
Mothra appears in  Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire.
Official GIF stickers showing the Boonie Bears interacting with King Kong were released on Weibo.
Kong appears in Fortnite.
the Suicide Squad appear in Justice League vs. Godzilla vs. Kong II.

King Leonardo and His Short Subjects.description: Boris Badenov from Rocky & Bullwinkle appears in the Hunter segment episode "Peek-A-Boo Pyramids".
Sweet Polly Purebred sings the theme song to The King and Odie Show in the fourth part of "The Tickle Feather Machine".
A clip from King Leonardo and His Short Subjects appears on a television screen in Track 29.

King of the Hat.description: Washing Machine makes a cameo in Indie Pogo.
Birthday is an assist in Fraymakers.

King of the Hill.description: The Hill family, Dale, Bill and Boomhauer appear in the Simpsons episode "Bart Star".
The King of the Hill episode "Nine Pretty Darn Angry Men" is a parody of 12 Angry Men, with the title also being a parody of the movie.
The Silver Surfer meets Hank Hill in a King of the Hill promo on Fox Kids.
Etno Polino from Space Goofs meets Hank Hill in a King of the Hill promo on Fox Kids.
E.T. is mentioned in the King Of The Hill episode "Of Mice And Little Green Men".
Hank Hill appears in the Off the Mark comic strip on May 25, 2003.
Manimal is mentioned in the King of the Hill episode "DaleTech".
Gene Ruttish (ATV's driver) from Twisted Metal: Head-On is based on Boomhauer from King of the Hill.
A King Of The Hill poster is shown in the South Park episode "Cartoon Wars Part 2".
Sid the Sloth advertises King of the Hill in a promo for Fox's Animation Domination block.

SpongeBob is mentioned in the King Of The Hill episode "Tears Of An Inflatable Clown". In the SpongeBob episode Pest of the West, when Sandy says, "That boy ain’t hooked up right", it is a reference to the quote "That boy ain’t right" from King of the Hill.
Lost is mentioned in the King Of The Hill episode "Untitled Blake McCormick Project".
Bobby is seen reading a comic called Unvincible, a parody of Invincible, in the King of the Hill episode "Behind Closed Doors".
Hank Hill appears in The Cleveland Show episodes Cleveland Live! and Das Shrimp Boot.
Characters from King of the Hill appear in the Family Guy episodes "Bigfat" and "All About Alana". Bobby Hill is one of the many characters Stewie morphs into in the episode "Boopa-Dee Bappa-Dee".
Hank Hill is mentioned in one of the fail messages from Infiltrating the Airship.
George Liquor from The Ren & Stimpy Show appears in an Adult Swim bumper alongside Hank Hill from King of the Hill.
Dale's truck from King of the Hill makes an appearance outside of Bob's restaurant in the episode "Aquaticism"
Bobby and Hank from King of the Hill are parodied in the Cell Vs episode "Cell Vs Bobby Hill".
King of the Hill is parodied in the MeatCanyon episode "That Boy Aint Right (Anime Parody)".
The main cast of King of the Hill appear as racers in Warped Kart Racers.
"King of the Hills" memorabilia can be seen in the Melvins Macabre episode "NOSTALGIA".
Hank Hill from King of the Hill appears in Fortnite.

King's Quest.description: Princess Rosella from King's Quest appears in Leisure Suit Larry Goes Looking for Love (in Several Wrong Places).
A picture of King Graham appears in a newspaper in Police Quest II: The Vengeance. Additionally, both series feature several other minor references to one another.

King Graham from King's Quest appears as an opponent in Hoyle's Official Book of Games: Volume 1, Volume 3, and Hoyle Classic Card Games. Princess Rosella from King's Quest appears as an opponent in Volume 1 and Volume 3. Lolotte and Mordack from King's Quest appear as opponents in Volume 3.
The Secret of Monkey Island contains several references to King's Quest.
The Quest for Daventry table in Take a Break! Pinball is based on King's Quest V.
The title of King's Quest VII: The Princeless Bride is a spoof of The Princess Bride.
Cedric from King's Quest V makes a cameo in Space Quest 6. Additionally, both series make several other minor references to one another.
A character named "King" Gramm appears in Baldur's Gate II and makes several references to King's Quest.
Peasant's Quest is a parody of King's Quest, and makes many references to it.
Minecraft features a painting of King Graham from King's Quest.
King Graham from King's Quest is playable in Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 5.

Kingdom (Shueisha).description: Monster Hunter XX features a special quest based on Kingdom with titles, guild card art and the sword of Ri-Hyou as unlockables, all as part of a limited promotion.
Characters from Kingdom appeared in Puzzle & Dragons during a special collaboration.
Union Arena features cards based on Kingdom.

Kingdom Come: Deliverance.description: In the Madonna Of Sasau quest in the A Woman's Lot DLC, Henry can ask a guard about Inquisitor Jaroslav. The guard will launch into an almost exact copy of the speech used by Kryten when asked about the Inquisitor.
Sir Radzig's sword and Zizka's mace from Kingdom Come: Deliverance II were added to Dead Island 2 as downloadable content.

Kingdom Dragonion.description: Kingdom Dragonion featured Goemon as a playable character.
Kingdom Dragonion featured Bomberman and red Bomber as playable units.
Kingdom Dragonion featured Twinbee and Winbee as playable characters.
Kingdom Dragonion featured Simon Belmont and Alucard as playable characters.

Kingdom Hearts.description: Many characters, items and general themes from the Final Fantasy series are featured prominently in the Kingdom Hearts series, while characters from Kingdom Hearts appear in World of Final Fantasy, Final Fantasy Record Keeper, and Final Fantasy Brave Exvius during special promotions; additionally three costumes from Kingdom Hearts are downloadable in Dissidia 012 Final Fantasy, and Kingdom Hearts Final Mix contains a trailer for Final Fantasy X-2.
The Kingdom Hearts series features many characters from the Mickey Mouse series. A keyblade appears in The Wonderful Spring of Mickey Mouse.
The Kingdom Hearts series features many characters from the Donald Duck series.
The Kingdom Hearts series features Chip and Dale. Also, Sora's hair and keyblade can be seen in the 2022 Chip 'n' Dale film.
Wonderland is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from Alice in Wonderland.
Olympus Coliseum is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from Hercules.
Deep Jungle is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from Tarzan.
Agrabah is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from Aladdin.
Jiminy Cricket makes his debut in Kingdom Hearts.  Also, Monstro is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from Pinocchio.
Atlantica is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from The Little Mermaid.
Halloween Town is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from The Nightmare Before Christmas.
Neverland is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from Peter Pan.
Simba can be summoned in the first two Kingdom Hearts games.  Also, Pride Lands is a stage in Kingdom Hearts II which also features characters from The Lion King.
Bambi can be summoned in Kingdom Hearts.
Dumbo can be summoned in Kingdom Hearts.
Mushu can be summoned in Kingdom Hearts. Also, Land of Dragons is a stage in Kingdom Hearts II which also features characters from Mulan.
Cinderella makes her debut in Kingdom Hearts. Also, Castle of Dreams is a stage in Kingdom Hearts: Birth by Sleep which also features characters from Cinderella.

Kingdom Hearts.game: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (Disney)
Kingdom Hearts.description: Snow White makes her debut in Kingdom Hearts. Also, Dwarf Woodlands is a stage in Kingdom Hearts: Birth by Sleep which also features characters from Snow White.
Belle makes her debut in Kingdom Hearts. Also, Beast's Castle is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from Beauty and the Beast.
Maleficent makes her debut in Kingdom Hearts. Also, Enchanted Dominion is a stage in Kingdom Hearts: Birth by Sleep which also features characters from Sleeping Beauty.
Merlin makes his debut in Kingdom Hearts.
Pongo, Perdita, and the 99 Puppies make a debut in Kingdom Hearts.
100 Acre Wood is a stage in Kingdom Hearts which also features characters from Winnie the Pooh.
Chernabog appears as a boss in Kingdom Hearts.
There is a fountain sculpted to look like the Lady and the Tramp at Traverse Town since the original Kingdom Hearts.

The Hunchback of Notre Dame characters appear in the Kingdom Hearts comic “The Sceptre and the Kingdom”.  Also, La Cité des Cloches is a stage in Kingdom Hearts: Dream Drop Distance which also features characters from The Hunchback of Notre Dame.
Port Royal is a stage in Kingdom Hearts II which also features characters from Pirates of the Carribean.
Space Paranoids is a stage in Kingdom Hearts II which also features characters from Tron.
Stitch can be summoned in Kingdom Hearts II. Also, Deep Space is a stage in Kingdom Hearts: Birth by Sleep which also features characters from Lilo & Stitch.
Chicken Little (2005 character) can be summoned in Kingdom Hearts II.
Sora's hair is unlockable in Pico Sim Date 2.
The Simpsons Game features a reference to Kingdom Hearts where two statutes depict Santa’s Little Helper holding the Kingdom Key.
Sora meets characters from The World Ends with You in Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance; additionally The World Ends with You uses the same gameplay style from Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories.
The Keybrand in Terraria is based on the Kingdom Key from Kingdom Hearts.
The avatars of Theatrythm are based on the avatars of Kingdom Hearts Mobile and Kingdom Hearts Re:coded.
In One Night at Flumpty's, there is a golden key, a reference to Kingdom Hearts.
A Kingdom Hearts themed icon can be unlocked in Emily is Away.
The Keyblade from Kingdom Hearts as well as an outfit based on the game can be unlocked in Disney Infinity 3.0.
Characters can dress up as Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. Medals of Judy Hopps, Nick Wilde, and Flash also appear in the game.

Medals of Baloo, Mowgli, and King Louie appear in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. There was going to be a stage based on The Jungle Book in Kingdom Hearts: Birth by Sleep, but was cut. An incomplete version can be played using cheat codes.
Female characters can dress up as Moana in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. Medals of Maui and Moana also appear in the game.
Aqua can wear Marie cat ears as part of her wardrobe in  Kingdom Hearts 0.2 Birth by Sleep -A fragmentary passage-.  Also, characters can dress up as Marie in Kingdom Hearts Union χ.
Game Central Station is a stage in Kingdom Hearts Union χ which also features characters from Wreck-It Ralph.  Also, Ralph can be summoned in Kingdom Hearts III.
Medals of Huey, Duey, Lewie, Webby, Scrooge McDuck, and Launchpad McQuack from DuckTales appear in Kingdom Hearts Union χ.
Sora and King Mickey have been subjects for Death Battle!
Medals of Miguel, Dante, and Héctor appear in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. Characters can dress up as Héctor and Miguel in Kingdom Hearts Union χ.
Medals of The Incredibles appear in Kingdom Hearts Union χ.
In Stormsong Valley of Warcraft: Battle of Azeroth, there are NPCs resembling Sora, Kairi, and Riku from Kingdom Hearts.
Kingdom Hearts is parodied in multiple Perfect Cell Vs episodes.
The Angry Video Game Nerd talks about the Kingdom Hearts series in the episode "Kingdom Hearts Timeline - Chronologically Confused".
The Kingdom of Corona is a stage in Kingdom Hearts III based on Tangled.
A stage in Kingdom Hearts III is based on Big Hero 6.
Buzz and Woody were suppose to be in Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix, but were cut. Their untextured models can be found in the game's code. A stage in Kingdom Hearts III is based on Toy Story.
A stage in Kingdom Hearts III is based on Monsters, Inc.
Arendelle is a stage in Kingdom Hearts III based on Frozen.
Remy makes his debut in Kingdom Hearts III.
The Air Droids in Kingdom Hearts III are named after droids from the Star Wars series.
Characters can dress up as Bernard and Bianca in Kingdom Hearts Union χ.
Medals of Barley and Ian Lightfoot appear in Kingdom Hearts Union χ.
Medals of 22, Joe, and Mr. Mittens appear in Kingdom Hearts Union χ.
One of the weapons that can be obtained in Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart looks similar to the Keyblade from Kingdom Hearts.
Xehanort has been a subject for DBX.
Kingdom Hearts is parodied in multiple Daitomodachi episodes.

Cloud's Triple Buster move in Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS / Wii U and Ultimate seems to resemble his Cross Slash from Kingdom Hearts games.  Also, Sora from Kingdom Hearts appears as a playable character in Super Smash Bros Ultimate, with a stage based on the series.
Kingdom Hearts is parodied in the Robot Chicken episode May Cause Numb Butthole.
The Keyblade from Kingdom Hearts can be found on display in a training hall in Nobody Saves the World.
KG is seen playing Kingdom Hearts in The Proud Family: Louder and Prouder episode “Home Schooled”.
Kingdom Hearts Tamagotchi is a Kingdom Hearts-themed Tamagotchi therefore being a format crossover between the two series.

Kings Watch.description: The Phantom appears in Kings Watch and Kings Quest.
Mandrake the Magician appears in Kings Watch and Kings Quest.
Flash Gordon appears in Kings Watch and Kings Quest.

Jack Bauer from 24 is mentioned in Kingsman: The Secret Service.
Sterling Archer meets Eggsy from Kingsman in a promo for Kingsman: The Golden Circle.
The Kingsman item in Fortnite is a reference to the Kingsman series.
Characters from Kingsman appear in Big Game.

Kinito made a cameo appearance in Dandy's World.
Creatures from KinitoPET can be found in Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts.

Kinnikuman.description: The original one-shot for Kinnikuman featured the Ultra Brothers. Later in the manga, Ultraman is mentioned multiple times by name.
Batman appears in both chapter 1 & 8 of the Kinnikuman manga.
Superman appears in both chapter 1 & 8 of the Kinnikuman manga.
Spider-Man appears in both chapter 1 & 8 of the Kinnikuman manga.
Wonder Woman appears in chapter 1 of the Kinnikuman manga.
Captain America appears in chapter 1 of the Kinnikuman manga.
Mister Fantastic of the Fantastic Four appears in chapter 1 of the Kinnikuman manga.
Kinnikuman is a playable character in the series.
The character Brocken from World Heroes is inspired by Brocken Jr. from Kinnikuman.
A mask that resembles Kinnikuman's mask can be seen at the Joy Division store in the PC Engine and later ports of Snatcher.
Several signature techniques from the Kinnikuman series are used by King and Armor King in several Tekken games.
Pop'n Music Animelo 2, Pop'n Music 10 and Pop'n Music 18 feature a track from Kinnikuman
The Fight for the FoxBox includes characters and actual clips from Ultimate Muscle: The Kinnikuman Legacy.
Various scenes in the Bobobo-bo Bo-bobo manga have characters parody scenes from Kinnikuman including having characters dress up like Warsman, Robin Mask and Terryman.
In the 30th-anniversary volume of KoichiKame called Chou KoichiKame, there is a chapter where they crossover with Kinnikuman.
There are two techniques in Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin which references techniques from Kinnikuman.
The Irate Gamer reviews Tag Team Match: MUSCLE on NES.
Taiko no Tatsujin 12, Taiko no Tatsujin 13 and Taiko no Tatsujin Plus feature a music track from Kinnikuman.
Zangief and El Fuerte's Ultra Combos from Super Street Fighter IV references finishing moves from the Kinnikuman series.
A visual allusion to Warsman's broken "Bear Claw" from Kinnikuman appears in Chapter 60 of the Assassination Classroom manga.
As part of special collaboration events, Puzzle & Dragons featured characters from the Kinnikuman series.
In Danganronpa V3, both Kokichi and Tsumugi reference the characters of Shumai and Ramenman from the Kinnikuman series.
In the Japanese version of ARMS, Min Min's title is Tatakau! Rāmen Shōjo which is a direct reference to the Kinnikuman spin-off series, Tatakae!! Ramenman.
Promotional items showing Kinnikuman characters fighting monsters from Monster Hunter, were released during a special collaboration.
Arino plays the Disk System game Kinnikuman: Kinnikusei Ōi Sōdatsusen as part of a DVD-exclusive challenge.
A special crossover manga chapter between Food Wars!: Shokugeki no Soma and Kinnikuman involving characters from both franchises was published in Kinnikuman Jump volume #5.
Union Arena features cards based on Kinnikuman.

Kipper the Dog.description: Kipper the Dog appears in Children's Party at the Palace.

Kirara Fantasia.description: Characters from Bocchi the Rock! appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from Is the Order a Rabbit? appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from School-Live! appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from Kin-iro Mosaic appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from New Game! appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from Kill Me Baby appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from Blend S appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from Laid-Back Camp appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from K-On appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from The Demon Girl Next Door appear in Kirara Fantasia.
Characters from Hello Kitty appear in Kirara Fantasia as part of the Sanrio collaboration.
Characters from Gudetama appear in Kirara Fantasia as part of the Sanrio collaboration.

Kirby.description: Kirby makes a cameo appearance during the opening sequence of Arcana. Additionally, the logo for Kirby Quest from Kirby Mass Attack is inspired by the logo for Arcana.
Lololo and Lalala from Kirby are based on Lolo and Lala from Eggerland, while Blocky is based on Rocky; Kirby Mass Attack also features other references to the series.

In Kirby Super Star and its DS remake, Mario characters; Mario, Luigi, Toad, Birdo, Peach, Bowser and Wario (remake) cameo in the audience of the final fight in the Spring Breeze subgame and Kirby can collect a Koopa Shell, Phanto Mask and Wario's Bucket as treasures in the Great Cave Offensive subgame. Recurring Kirby boss Kabula fires what appear to be Bullet Bills during some attacks and Kirby's Stone ability has a rare chance of turning into a golden statue of Mario. Kirby appears in Mario comics such as Super Mario-Kun and cameos on a movie poster in Mario and Luigi: Superstar Saga.
Pac-Man and Inky appear in the comic Kirby und das Geheimnis des Glibbers. Pacto is based on Pac-Man.
Plok appears in the comic Kirby und das Geheimnis des Glibbers.
Pit appears in the comic Kirby und das Geheimnis des Glibbers. A Wing of Pegasus is an obtainable item in Kirby Super Star.
Aero the Acro-Bat appears in the comic Kirby und das Geheimnis des Glibbers.
Dizzy Devil and Hamilton J. Pig appear in the comic Kirby und das Geheimnis des Glibbers.

Donkey Kong Jr. appears in the comic Kirby und das Geheimnis des Glibbers. The "Kong's Barrel" is an obtainable item in Kirby Super Star; the theme from the Kirby TV show is featured in the Japanese and North American versions of Donkey Konga, while a song from Kirby's Adventure is featured in Donkey Konga 3.
Mega Man X appears in the comic Kirby und das Geheimnis des Glibbers.
Kirby appears as an enemy in The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening, while the Triforce is an obtainable item in Kirby Super Star. There also are other references between the two series.
Kirby appears on billboards in Stunt Race FX.
Kirby's Avalanche is a remake of Super Puyo Puyo.
Chao from Yuyuki appears in the Japanese version of Kirby's Dream Land 2 and with Goku in Kirby's Dream Land 3.
Wario meets Kirby in the comic Warios Weihnachtsmärchen; the bucket from Mario & Wario is an obtainable item in Kirby Super Star.
The Screw Attack ball is an obtainable item in Kirby Super Star, while Metroids and Samus appear in Kirby's Dream Land 3.
Captain Falcon's Helmet is an obtainable item in Kirby Super Star.
Marth's Falchion is an obtainable item in Kirby Super Star.
Mr. Saturn is an obtainable "item" in Kirby Super Star.
You can find a treasure in Kirby Super Star called the "Indy Whip" in Japan. Additionally, the Whip Copy Ability is based on Indiana Jones.

Gabon from Kirby is based on Cubone and Marowak from Pokémon. In Pokémon Stadium 2, connecting video game consoles to a TV can show images from Kirby's Adventure and 'Kirby Super Star. Pokémon Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum feature a reference to Kirby.
Donbe and Hikari from Shin Onigashima make a cameo in Kirby's Dream Land 3.
R.O.B. makes a cameo in Kirby's Dream Land 3.

Characters, places and items from the Kirby series are featured in all Super Smash Bros. games; Master Hand and Crazy Hand from the Super Smash Bros. series appear in Kirby & The Amazing Mirror; many other Kirby games as well as the comic strip Kirby and the Rainbow Curse: Saved by the Rainbow feature references to the Super Smash Bros. series; Kirby and the Rainbow Curse, Kirby: Planet Robobot and Team Kirby Clash Deluxe feature compatibility with Super Smash Bros. amiibo. Sandbag from Super Smash Bros. appears in Kirby Air Riders.
Kirby appears in N-Gang episodes "Freeze Frame" and "Die Hexe lacht um Mitternacht".
Picross NP Vol. 3 and Rittai Picross 2 include images from the Kirby series.
In Kirby 64: The Crystal Shards, the Spark-Cutter Power Combo is a reference to the double-bladed lightsaber.
In Un-Reality TV, Globzilla is a parody of Godzilla.
In Un-Reality TV, King Klong is a parody of King Kong.
In Un-Reality TV, Super Dededeman is a parody of Superman.
The episode A Novel Approach has a reference to Harry Potter.
The Fight for the FoxBox includes characters and actual clips from Kirby: Right Back at Ya!.
A medley of Kirby's music tracks is featured in Daigasso! Band Brothers.
Carvai in Aoi Sekai no Chushin de is based on Kirby.
A Waddle Doo from Kirby appears in I Wanna Be The Guy.

The Gold Watering Can from Animal Crossing is an obtainable item in Kirby Super Star Ultra; one of the designs in the Animal Crossing e-Reader cards is based on Kirby; in Kirby: Planet Robobot Stone Kirby can turn into a Tom Nook statue, and the game also features compatibility with Animal Crossing amiibo.
Scott Pilgrim vs. the World: The Game features a star similar to Kirby's Warp Star.
The Angry Video Game Nerd episode "How The Nerd Stole Christmas" features a reference to Kirby.
A statue from Kirby Super Star can be found in Toilet in Wonderland.
Mii Plaza features unlockable hats based on the Kirby series and includes five Puzzle Swap puzzles based on Kirby games.
The Star Pics AR game uses a Kirby card, and there also are Kirby refereneces in Graffiti.
A Kirby hat is featured in Nintendogs + Cats.
The core gameplay concept of Kirby Mass Attack is very similar to that of the Pikmin games.
In Kirby's Return to Dream Land, Goriath is a reference to Saiyan warriors from Dragon Ball.
Random Encounters has made a Kirby song.
Anthony gains the power of Kirby in I Have Kirby Powers!.
Geometry Dash features skins based on Kirby and Meta Knight and a ship skin based on the Jet Star.
In Kirby: Triple Deluxe, the battle with King Phanta is a reference to Luigi's Mansion.

Kirby.game: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (Disney)
Kirby.description: In Kirby: Triple Deluxe, Queen Sectonia is said to have been bewitched by a magic mirror and driven mad with the desire for perfect beauty and power. This is a nod to the tale of Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
NES Remix 2 includes challenges based on Kirby's Adventure.
Kirby and King Dedede have been subjects for Death Battle!
Scanning an Amiibo in Amiibo Tap: Nintendo's Greatest Bits can give you access to playing a demo of Kirby's Adventure, Kirby Super Star, Kirby's Dream Land 3, or Kirby's Dream Course.
Nintendo Badge Arcade features badges based on the Kirby series.
Kirby's Warp Star appears as an option in Fleeing the Complex.
Kirby appears in comic strips within BoxBoxBoy and Bye-Bye BoxBoy! and there are some minor references between the two series.
Four planets from Kirby Super Star, Floria, Aqualiss, Mecheye, and Halfmoon, are mentioned on the cover of a travel magazine in Star Fox Zero: The Battle Begins.
Kirby: Planet Robobot features compatibility with Splatoon amiibo.
Kirby: Planet Robobot features compatibility with the Chibi-Robo amiibo.
Kirby appears in Clássicos do Cinema - Turma da Mônica #52.

Kirby and King Dedede are party members in Taiko no Tatsujin: Dokodon! Mystery Adventure and Kirby also returns in Taiko no Tatsujin: Nintendo Switch Version!; Taiko no Tatsujin: Dokodon! Mystery Adventure and Red Version also feature songs from the Kirby series, with a Meta Knight costume also available in Arcade games.
King Dedede and Meta Knight have been subjects for DBX.
Miitomo featured Kirby-themed items.
Miitopia features a costume based on Kirby, obtainable by scanning the Kirby amiibo.
Geometry Dash features a skin based on Kirby.
Poochi & Yoshi's Woolly World features a Yoshi design based on Waddle Dee, unlocked by using the respective amiibo.
A TV in the chapter "Train Rush" from A Hat in Time shows a parody of the "How to Draw" intro of Kirby's Adventure.
Girls Mode 4 features clothing items based on the Kirby series, unlocked by using Kirby amiibo.
Part Time UFO includes a level with dolls of Kirby characters.
A Pop Team Epic skit in Episode 2 of the anime featured a menu screen similar to the one in Kirby Super Star.
Mario enters a parody version of the world of Kirby in "If Mario was in... Kirby Star Allies".
The Kirby series is parodied in several episodes of Something About.
Kirby is mentioned in Ask Orange #43: Pear-achu!.
Kirby is parodied in the Perfect Cell Vs episode "Perfect Cell Vs Super Smash Bros  Ultimate."
Tetris 99 featured a Super Kirby Clash theme and a Kirby Fighters 2 theme during limited events.

King Dedede's hammer and a Mr. Star pillow appear in the shop as hand items. There are also shaman items: Star Block small and large box skins, Kirby ball and anvil skins, and a Meta Knight cannonball skin.
The Chapter 6 introduction cutscene in Super Meat Boy Forever is a parody of the intro cutscene from Kirby's Adventure.
A tree looking like Whispy Woods appears in "Beaster Bunny".
A tree similar in appearance to Whispy Woods appears in "MÁS NOTÍCIAS...".
Dream Land was mentioned in Chapter 2 of Protect Me, Shugomaru!, as well as other references.
In Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Wonder and Wondy are similar to Mickey and Minnie.
Somebody in an Kirby costume can be found in Spooky Month episode “Tender Treats”.
A statue of Kirby can be seen in the MeatCanyon episode "Death of an NPC Simp".
Kirby memorabilia can be seen in the Melvins Macabre episode "NOSTALGIA".
A version of Kirby's Adventure for the NES is included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition.
The "Superstar Warrior" spray in Antonblast is based on Kirby.

Kirby Buckets.description: In a limited-time event in Roblox, players could use weapons from Kirby Buckets.
Laughy Cat from Kirby Buckets cameos in an episode of Lab Rats.
A promotional video released in 2015 for Doctor Who's arrival on Disney XD featured the TARDIS entering the school from Kirby Buckets, with Kirby having already drawn the ship.

Alice Mononobe of Nijisanji appears alongside Kizuna AI in a video.

Kizuna AI appears in Epic Seven as part of a special collaboration.

Skins based on Kizuna AI appear in Fall Guys.
