Monkey Island.description: Cobb from Loom appears in The Secret of Monkey Island. The seagull from Loom appears in The Secret of Monkey Island and Monkey Island 2: LeChuck's Revenge.
The Secret of Monkey Island contains several references to King's Quest.

Sam and Max make appearances as an idol, as costumes and as shadows in the first three episodes of Monkey Island, and are referenced in Escape from Monkey Island; the Sam & Max: Freelance Police stories on issues 1 and 14 of The Adventurer are parodies of The Secret of Monkey Island, and there also is a reference to the game in Sam & Max Hit the Road.
There are references to Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure in Monkey Island 2: LeChuck's Revenge and Escape from Monkey Island.
Manny Calavera makes a cameo as a skeleton in The Curse of Monkey Island.
In The Curse of Monkey Island the gravedigger Mort has a book titled " Zombies ate my neighbours".

Indiana Jones briefly enters the Monkey Island universe in the game Indiana Jones and the Infernal Machine; additionally Guybrush briefly turns into Indy in the demo version of The Secret of Monkey Island and there's a book written by "I. Jones" in Monkey Island 2.
The "Monkey Kombat" minigame in Escape from Monkey Island is a parody of Mortal Kombat.

The entrance to the cave that must be opened at the end of the Pirate Island area in Asterix & Obelix XXL 2 is shaped like the head of a monkey, possibly referencing the Giant Monkey Head from Monkey Island.

Chuck the Plant from Maniac Mansion can be found at the beginning of Tales of Monkey Island; additionally the tentacle from Maniac Mansion: Day of the Tentacle appears as an idol in The Secret of Monkey Island: Special Edition and as a costume in Monkey Island 2: Special Edition.
An alter-ego of Guybrush Threepwood called Guybrush Threepkiller is unlockable in Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II; The Curse of Monkey Island also contains several references to Star Wars.
Poker Night at the Inventory and its sequel feature Reginald Van Winslow from Tales of Monkey Island as the host.
Guybrush Threepwood and LeChuck appear in Clássicos do Cinema - Turma da Mônica #30.
Assassin's Creed IV includes a reference to pirate Mancomb Seepgood from The Secret of Monkey Island.
The character Mancomb in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is based on Guybrush Threepwood.
Guybrush is shown to be one of the  twelve pirate captains that founded Libertalia in Uncharted 4: A Thief's End.

Sea of Thieves: A Pirate's Life includes an optional quest featuring references to Monkey Island, and specifically including the journals of Kate Capsize from Monkey Island 2 as well as the Tri Island Area map charting islands from the whole series. Additionally, a crossover expansion for Sea of Thieves was released where you could visit Monkey Island.

Monster Hunter.description: "Zenny", the currency from Black Tiger, appears in the Monster Hunter series.
The Monster Hunter weapons "Undertaker" and "Ancient Gyrelance" are inspired by Jihad/Blade's sword from Red Earth.
The Low-Rank Ludroth Cap for males from Monster Hunter Tri is designed after Shiba Shintaro's headgear and hairstyle from Cannon Spike.
MonHan Diary: Poka Poka Felyne Village features costumes based on Hello Kitty while Monster Hunter-themed Hello Kitty plush dolls were also released.
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker features monsters from Monster Hunter, while Monster Hunter Portable 3rd features clothes based on Metal Gear characters.
A character from Monster Hunter 3 is playable in Lost Planet 2 as a downloadable skin, while "Monster Hunter" is one of the unlockable Nom de Guerres in Lost Planet 2.
Monster Hunter Frontier features downloadable weapons and costumes from Dead Rising 2.
Monster Hunter Portable 3rd and Monster Hunter 3G feature a downloadable weapon based on Negima! Magister Negi Magi.

Monster Hunter Portable 3rd and Monster Hunter Generations feature downloadable costumes and weapons based on Baki: Son of Ogre and Baki the Grappler, while Monster Hunter XX features a downloadable Felyne costume based on Baki-Dou.
Monster Hunter Portable 3rd and Monster Hunter 3G feature a downloadable weapon from Inuyasha.
Monster Hunter Portable 3rd and Monster Hunter Generations feature downloadable costumes from the manga Crows.
Monster Hunter Portable 3rd and Monster Hunter XX feature costumes from the Detective Conan series.
Monster Hunter Frontier and Monster Hunter Explore feature downloadable costumes based on Morrigan and Demitri from the Darkstalkers series.
One of the game's achievements, now known as advancements in the Java Edition, is named, "Monster Hunter", an achievement after you successfully killed a hostile mob, is a reference to the series.
Monster Hunter 3G, Monster Hunter Frontier G and Monster Hunter Explore feature downloadable costumes and weapons from Attack on Titan.
A Melynx from Monster Hunter makes a cameo appearance during Interlude 10 in Asura's Wrath, banners showing Felyne from Monster Hunter can also be seen during Interlude 22.

The list of generic monickers in Dragon's Dogma features "Felyne" as a possible monicker, while Dragon's Dogma Online features Rathalos and Rathian-based armors, Felyne masks and the "Proof of a Hero" theme as part of a special event.
MonHun Card Master is a format crossover between both series, while Minna to Capcom All Stars and Street Fighter × All Capcom feature characters from the Monster Hunter series.

Onimusha Souls has special collaboration events with Monster Hunter Portable 3rd and Monster Hunter Frontier G, including a giant Onimusha-themed Felyne as an enemy and a 2nd collaboration bringing in the Yama Tsukai from Monster Hunter as well, while Monster Hunter Frontier and Frontier G feature costumes based on Onimusha armors.

Monster Hunter: Frontier G features downloadable weapons and costumes from Fate/stay night, Monster Hunter Explore features costumes, weapons and a special monster based on Fate/Stay night: Unlimited Blade Works, and a later collaboration features costumes and weapons from Fate/EXTELLA LINK, Monster Hunter Frontier Z features downloadable costumes and weapons from Fate/EXTELLA and Fate/Apocrypha.
Monster Hunter: Frontier G features downloadable weapons and costumes based on Hatsune Miku.
Monster Hunter 4, Monster Hunter X, Monster Hunter Stories and Monster Hunter XX feature costumes based on Link, along with weapons from the Zelda series.
Monster Hunter 4 includes costumes based on Mario and Luigi, while Super Mario Maker features a costume based on the felyne.
As part of special collaboration events, creatures from the Monster Hunter series appeared in Puzzle & Dragons and in Puzzle & Dragons Radar (with Soul Armors for the leader to wear).

Monster Hunter Frontier and Monster Hunter Explore feature downloadable weapons and costumes from Sengoku BASARA; while Sengoku BASARA 4 Sumeragi features a DLC costume pack based on characters and armor from Monster Hunter.
Several cats from the MonHun Poka Poka Airyuu Village subseries are featured in Otoranger.

Several monsters from Monster Hunter and cats from the MonHan Diary subseries are selectable in Street Fighter × All Capcom; while Monster Hunter Frontier G features downloadable costumes based on Ryu, Chun-Li, Cammy and Ken, Monster Hunter X features Palico armor sets based on Chun-Li and Blanka, Monster Hunter Explore features costumes of Ryu, Chun-li, Rashid and Karin and a weapon based on M.Bison, Monster Hunter World features Ryu and Sakura as playable characters and Cammy's codename "Killer Bee" is a title given to the player in Monster Hunter Tri. The Gore Magala from Monster Hunter appears as a boss in Street Fighter: Duel during a collaboration event.

Monster Hunter: Frontier G and Monster Hunter 4 Ultimate feature downloadable outfits and weapons from the Devil May Cry series, with Dante also appearing as a hireable "Rasta" in Frontier G; MonHun Big Game Hunting Quest features cards of several Devil May Cry characters; Monster Hunter Explore features costumes and weapons of Dante, Lady, Vergil and Trish, and Monster Hunter World features a Dante costume with his weapons and special moves.
The Wii U version of Monster Hunter: Frontier G and Monster Hunter: Generations feature downloadable outfits and weapons from the Fire Emblem series.
Monster Hunter 4 features downloadable weapons and costumes from One Piece; Chopper also makes an appearance as a Felyne skin.
Mii Plaza includes a Puzzle Swap puzzle based on Monster Hunter.
Characters from the MonHan series appeared in Puyo Puyo!! Quest and vice versa during special events.
Hyperdevotion Noire: Goddess Black Heart features a character called Moru, that parodies the Monster Hunter series.

Two felyne from the MonHan Diary series are party members in Taiko no Tatsujin: Don to Katsu no Jikuu Daibouken; various games in the Taiko no Tatsujin series also feature music tracks from the Monster Hunter series, with Taiko no Tatsujin: Wii U Version also featuring a Felyne costume for Don-chan, while Monster Hunter 4g/Ultimate features a Don-chan-themed weapon.

As part of a special collaboration, a "Diorekkusu" monster from Monster Hunter appeared in Hyaku Nen Senki: Euro Historia and a set of Euro Historia armors were accessible in Monster Hunter Frontier G.
Monster Hunter: Frontier G features downloadable outfits and weapons from The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki II.
MonHun Big Game Hunting Quest and Monster Strike had a collaboration event where monsters and characters from one series appeared in the other.
Monster Hunter 4G/Ultimate features the Varia Suit and Zero Suit costumes from Metroid, along with the Arm Cannon weapon; Monster Hunter X also features a collaboration event with Metroid.
Monster Hunter 4G/Ultimate features downloadable costumes from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure.
Monster Hunter: Frontier G and Monster Hunter Explore feature downloadable outfits and weapons from Puella Magi Madoka Magica.
Monster Hunter 4 and Monster Hunter X feature downloadable weapons from Magi, while Monster Hunter Explore features costume and weapon sets as part of a speciall collaboration.
Monster Hunter 3G features a downloadable Keroro mask, while MonHun Big Game Hunting Quest features characters and a story event as part of a special collaboration.

MonHun Big Game Hunting Quest features characters and a story event from Resident Evil Revelations 2 as part of a special collaboration, while Monster Hunter Explore features two collaborations including costumes of a zombie, Jill, Rebecca and Tyrant as well as weapons and monsters designed after the Resident Evil HD Remaster.
Several theme songs from Monster Hunter 4, Generations and Frontier are featured in CROSS×BEATS REV.

The world of Monster Hunter is visited in Sonic and Megaman: Worlds Unite Part 10 - Justice Across Worlds, including appearances of Felyne, Palico and Gore Magala; Monster Hunter 4g/Ultimate and Rise feature downloadable costumes based on Sonic the Hedgehog. Costumes based on Monster Hunter appeared in Sonic Frontiers after an update.

The world of Monster Hunter is visited in Sonic and Megaman: Worlds Unite Part 10 - Justice Across Worlds, including appearances of Felyne, Palico and Gore Magala; Monster Hunter 4G/Ultimate, Monster Hunter X and Monster Hunter World feature a Mega Man-themed Palico armor set and a Rush-themed weapon.

A Felyne appears in Animal Crossing: Happy Home Designer by scanning a Monster Hunter Stories amiibo; additionally Monster Hunter 4G/Ultimate features downloadable outfits based on Isabelle and Mister Resetti from the Animal Crossing series.
A parody of Monster Hunter can be seen during the intro of Himouto! Umaru-chan.
Characters from Monster Hunter Big Game Hunting Quest appear in The Battle Cats as a part of a collaboration.
There has been a series of Monster Hunter - Gudetama promotional material; Monster Hunter X also features a costume based on Gudetama.
Monster Hunter X features a downloadable costume based on Macross Delta.
The Duel Masters card Kushala Daora, Steel Dragon features the Kushala Daora from Monster Hunter.
Monster Hunter X features a downloadable costume from Star Fox.

Breath of Fire 6 features special hunter costumes from Monster Hunter Frontier G, while Frontier G featured costumes of Ryu and Nina from Breath of Fire III; later collaboration events include a Monster Hunter Explore armor set, Rathalos-based weapons, Felyne unlockable character and a special story event in Breath of Fire 6 and a costume set of Ryu and Nina from 6 in Monster Hunter Explore.
Nintendo Badge Arcade features badges based on the Monster Hunter series.
Monster Hunter Generations features Strider Hiryu's Cypher sword and a special armor set based on his uniform.
Monster Hunter Explore features costumes, weapons and a special monster from Evangelion as part of a special collaboration.

Monster Hunter Generations features a special Palico armor and weapon set based on Arthur from Ghosts 'n Goblins, while Monster Hunter Rise features a DLC armor set based on Arthur from Ghosts 'n Goblins Resurrection.
Monster Hunter Generations features a downloadable costume from Yu-Gi-Oh.

A special collaboration between Final Fantasy Brave Exvius and Monster Hunter Explore includes a "Hunter" unit, weapons and an exclusive boss battle in the former, and costumes, weapons and a Moogle in the latter; Monster Hunter World features creatures from Final Fantasy XIV and vice versa during a collaboration; Monster Hunter 4G/Ultimate and Monster Hunter X also feature a downloadable costume from Final Fantasy; Rathalos from Monster Hunter appears in Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis as part of a crossover event.

DLC costume sets based on Phoenix Wright, Maya Fey, Miles Edgeworth and Franziska von Karma are featured in Monster Hunter Explore, while a Felyne costume based on Phoenix Wright is featured in Monster Hunter XX.
Monster Hunter Frontier Z and Monster Hunter Explore feature characters, weapons and a story event from Imperial SaGa as part of special collaborations.
Monster Hunter Frontier Z features a weapon and items from Nier:Automata as part of a special collaboration.

Monster Hunter XX features a downloadable Palico costume based on Luna from Sailor Moon, as well as the Cutie Moon Rod as a weapon; a Felyne is also shown transforming the same way as Sailor Moon in the trailer for the DLC.
Monster Hunter XX features a special quest based on Kingdom with titles, guild card art and the sword of Ri-Hyou as unlockables, all as part of a limited promotion.
Monster Hunter XX features a downloadable costume based on "adult" Gon from Hunter × Hunter.

Monster Rancher.description: The monster breed "Ardebaran" from Monster Rancher is patterned after the creature from Tecmo's Deception, while the breed "Time Noise" from Monster Rancher 2 is patterned after Millenia from Kagero: Deception II. Suezo is a secret trap in Kagero's Deception II and Deception IV: Another Princess.

Lei Fang in the PlayStation version of Dead or Alive has a costume based on the pixie from Monster Rancher, while toys of "Suezo" and "False Suezo" can be found in the Survival Mode from Dead or Alive 2: Hardcore and the "Tecmo 50th Anniversary DLC" pack for Dead or Alive 5 Last Round features various costumes based on Monster Rancher; additionally a Pixie-breed monster based on Kasumi from Dead or Alive appears in several Monster Rancher games and another based on Ayame appears on Monster Rancher Advanced 2.
Having saved data of Monster Rancher unlocks the special "Champ" dragon in Dragonseeds.
The monster species "Wracky" from Monster Rancher 2 is inspired by Chucky.
The monster species "Joker" from Monster Rancher 2 is inspired by Death Thirteen from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure.
The monster species "Zilla" from Monster Rancher 2 is inspired by Godzilla.
The monster breed "GabooSoldier" from Monster Rancher 2 is patterned after Solid Snake from Metal Gear Solid.
The monster breed "Deluxe Liner" from Monster Rancher 2 is patterned after the Titanic and unlocked by using the Titanic movie OST.
The monster breed "Ninja Kato" from Monster Rancher 2 resembles Rikimaru and is unlocked by using the Tenchu: Stealth Assassins video game CD.
The monster breed "Metal Jell" from Monster Rancher 2 is patterned after the T-1000 from Terminator 2: Judgment Day.
The description on the "Metal Jell" monster from Monster Rancher 2 makes a reference to the Metal Slime from Dragon Quest.
The monster breed "Pithecan" from Monster Rancher 2 has a pattern resembling Fred Flintstone's clothes.
Monster Rancher Explorer is a repurposed version of the Japanese original, Solomon's Key. Solomon's Key included references to Monster Rancher.
The monster breed "BariRoller"/"MotoRoller" from Monster Rancher 3 and Monster Rancher Advanced is a reference to the MotoGP series.
The monster breed "Ibuki" from Monster Rancher Advanced is patterned after the Xenomorphs of Alien.
A Pipo Ape, Pirate Ape, and Red Shorts Ape all appear in Monster Rancher 4.
The monster breed "RygaRoller" from Monster Rancher 4 is patterned after the protagonist of Rygar.
The monster breed "Miku" from Monster Rancher 4 and My Monster Rancher is patterned after Miku Hinasaki from Fatal Frame.

A costume based on Pixie from Monster Rancher appears in Super Swing Golf 2.

Suezo from Monster Rancher is playable in Super Monkey Ball: Banana Mania as DLC.

Ultra Kaiju Monster Rancher is a crossover game between both series, while the Monster Rancher 2 breed "Ultrarl", the Monster Rancher Advance breed "Altima" and the Monster Rancher EVO breed "SueAlien" are inspired by Ultraman.

Mr. Driller.description: Mr. Driller is a spin-off of the Dig Dug series; Mr. Driller also makes an appearance in Dig Dug: Digging Strike, and various characters from the series appear in the Dig Dug 30th Anniversary webcomic.
Mr. Dig is a clone of Mr. Driller.
Mr Driller 2 reveals Susumu Hori's mother to be the protagonist of Baraduke Tobi "Kissy" Masuyo; she and a Paccet make later appearances in the series.
Smash Court 3 features Susumu Hori from Mr. Driller as a playable character.
In Xenosaga Episode 1 the character Mr. Holgar references the Drill Council and Susumu Hori from Mr. Driller.
Taiko no Tatsujin 3 and later games in the series feature music tracks from Mr. Driller, while Mr. Driller Ace: Fushigi no Pacteria features two Pacteria named and based on Katsu and Don.

Mr Driller Ace: Fushigi no Pacteria features a Pacteria named and based on Mappy.

A costume of Susumu Hori is featured in Tales of the World: Narikiri Dungeon 2 and 3 with his actual techniques, while a DLC costume of Susumu is included in Tales of Vesperia and the Tales of Arise artifact "Ancient Excavator" is the drill from Mr. Driller.

Mr Driller Drill Land features a stage titled "Hole of Druaga", including cameos from enemies, Gilgamesh and Ki; Mr. Driller Ace features two dungeons resembling and named after enemies, "Quox Ruins" and "Druaga Ruins", as well as a Pacteria based on Gilgamesh.

Kotoba no Puzzle Mojipittan for PlayStation 2 features Mr. Driller characters running in the background and a remix of a Mr. Driller theme in certain puzzles, while Kotoba no Puzzle Mojipittan Encore features a set of stages based on characters and items from Mr. Driller.

Mr. Driller is included in NamCollection.

New Space Order.description: The planet buster unit used by the Sacred Religious State in New Space Order is based on the Zolgear from Galaxian³: Attack of the Zolgear, while the Dragoon IDS from the United Galaxy faction in New Space Order -Link of Life is a mass-produced successor of the Dragoon from Galaxian³: Project Dragoon.
The setting of the United Galaxy faction in New Space Order featured organizations from Ace Combat 3: Electrosphere.

The line of spaceships known as "Geo Calibur 2" in New Space Order are based on the Geo Calibur from StarBlade: Operation Blue Planet, while the Geo Sword from StarBlade is referenced in the short story.

The Solvalou from Xevious is referenced in New Space Order Short Story, while a ship unit from the United Galaxy faction is based on the Solvalou and the Sacred Religious State's language is based on the Xevi language.

Two of the nations in New Space Order -Link of Life- employ the Melnics language from Tales of Eternia and the Sacred Religious State faction has ties to indicate it is the distant future of the world in Eternia.
One possible map arrangement in New Space Order is based on the maze from Pac-Man.
According ot the scenario writer for New Space Order the setting of the State of Feudal Dynasty faction is the distant future of the setting in Mirai Ninja.

2B, A2, and Pascal from NieR:Automata appear in Goddess of Victory: NIKKE as part of a collaboration event. A rerun with new costumes summer for 2B and A2 in July 3, 2025.
2B from NieR:Automata appeared in Granblue Fantasy Versus Rising as part of a special collaboration.
A DLC expansion for Stellar Blade was released that featured costumes and cosmetics based on NieR:Automata as well as Emil as a shopkeeper.
Costumes based in 2B, 9S and Commander White from NieR:Automata appear in Call of Duty: Mobile as part of a collaboration.
A bot based on 2B from NieR:Automata can be found in Astro Bot after an update.
Costumes based on 2B & A2 from NieR:Automata appeared in The First Descendant as part of a collaboration.

Night Blights.description: A magazine of Bubsy appears on the kitchen table in Night Blights.
An Aku Aku mask appears on a wall in Night Blights.
A Crystal Dragon Statue appears in the game Night Blights.
In Night Blights, you can see a drawing of Thomas in the basement.
In Night Blights, there is a game about shooting Night Blights in space, a reference to Space Invaders.
There is a minor reference to Portal in Night Blights.
A ONaF drawing features a face similar to a Night Blight.

Night Court.description: Wile E. Coyote from Looney Tunes appears in the Night Court episode "Still Another Day in the Life".
In the 30 Rock episode "The One with the Cast of Night Court", cast members from Night Court are reunited to stage a wedding between two characters from Night Court.

Night Man.description: Wolverine and Night Man have a crossover in Night Man vs. Wolverine.
Gambit and Night Man have a crossover in Night Man / Gambit.
Jonathan Chase from Manimal appears in the Night Man episode "Manimal".

Night Striker.description: The Inter Gray from Night Striker appears in Cameltry holding a 1000 Pts sign if the player reaches the goal with more than 60 seconds on the clock.
One of the players in the "Taito Planets" team from Super Kyuukyoku Harikiri Stadium 2 is named "Naisuto", after the series' Japanese name (Naito Sutoraikaa).
The Inter Gray from Night Striker is a DLC plane in Dariusburst Chronicle Saviours as part of the Taito DLC Pack.
Music from Night Striker can be played in D4DJ Groovy Mix after an update.

Night at the Museum.description: Batman is mentioned in Night at The Museum.
In Night at the Museum 2: Battle of the Smithsonian, Nicky owns a Spartan figure.
Dorothy's Ruby Slippers appead in Night at the Museum 2: Battle of the Smithsonian.
Princess Jasmine is mentioned in Night at the Museum 2: Battle of the Smithsonian.
In Night at the Museum 2: Battle of the Smithsonian, George Armstrong Custer says "Fly, you fool!".
Titanic is mentioned in Night at the Museum: Battle of the Smithsonian.
Oscar The Grouch appears in Night at The Museum 2: Battle of the Smithsonian.
Darth Vader appears in Night at The Museum 2: Battle of the Smithsonian.
In Night at the Museum 2: Battle of the Smithsonian, one fight scene parodies 300.
The Ben 10: Omniverse episode: "Fight at the Museum"'s title is a reference to "Night at the Museum".
A performance of Camelot appears in Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb.
An employee is seen playing Candy Crush in Night at the Museum 3: Secret of the Tomb.
World of Warcraft is mentioned in Night at the Museum 3: Secret of the Tomb.
Wolverine is mentioned in Night at the Museum 3: Secret of the Tomb.
Night at the Museum is shown on TV in the Rick and Morty episode: "Night Family".
In Night at the Museum: Kahmunrah Rises Again, Kahmunrah mentions Mufasa.
The Nostalgia Critic reviews Night at the Museum.

Night in the Woods.description: Dino Run DX features hats based on Night in the Woods characters.
Mae's outfit from Night in the Woods can be found in The Owl House episode “Thanks to Them”.
Night in the Woods can be seen written on a list of "Indies to catch up on" in the music video for FNAF Kids.

Night of the Consumers.description: Copies of Haunted PS1 Demo Disc 2020 can be found in Night of the Consumers.
A Baldi keychain can be found in Night of the Consumers.
Dolls that look similar to Teletubbies can be found in Night of the Consumers.
The Manager from Night of the Consumers makes a guest appearance in EEK3 2020 Virtual Show Floor.

Nightbreed.description: Pinhead fought Nightbreed in Hellraiser vs Nightbreed: Jihad.
Nightbreed fought Rawhead Rex in Nightbreed vs Rawhead Rex.

Nightmare Cops.description: Jason, Chris, and Stan appear in the background of the Week 5 mall in Friday Night Funkin'.

Nights of Azure.description: Gust from Hyperdimension Neptunia appears as a Servan in Nights of Azure as DLC.
Arnice and Christophorus from Nights of Azure appear as playable characters in Warriors All-Stars.
A costume based on Nights of Azure 2 appeared in Blue Reflection as part of a special collaboration and vice versa.

Nijisanji.description: Alice Mononobe of Nijisanji appears alongside Kizuna AI in a video.

Sasaki Saku and Lize Helesta wear commemorative costumes as part of a collaboration with Valkyrie Connect. Additionally, characters from Nijisanji appear in Valkyrie Connect as part of the collaboration event.
Various Nijisanji characters are obtainable in Last Period as part of a collaboration event.
Kuzuha, Sister Claire and Debidebi Debiru of Nijisanji appeared in Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIV as downloadable content.
Members of Vshojo appeared alongside members of Nijisanji on several occasions.
Haru Kaida appears in Obey Me! as part of a special collaboration.
Music from Nijisanji was added to maimai in the maimai UNiVERSE version.
Crunchyroll-Hime appeared alongside Nijisanji members in videos on several occasions.
DEbidebi Debiru appears in Kemono Friends 3 for a collaboration event.
Rindou Mikoto and Naraka appear in Clover Theater as part of a special collaboration.
Kuzuha appears in #COMPASS Live Arena as part of a special collaboration.
Members of Hololive appeared in videos alongside members of Nijisanji on several occasions.
Arino plays several NES games with Hyakumantenbara Salome. In addition, her channel features Arino playing Resident Evil 7 plus several N64 games with herself as a back-to-back collaboration.
Members of Nijisanji appeared in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival as part of a special collaboration.

Nikki (Nintendo).description: Nikki makes an appearance to teach a lesson in Art Academy: Lessons for Everyone!
Nintendo Badge Arcade features badges based on Nikki.
Super Mario Maker features a costume based on Nikki.
A ghost named “Ikki” in the game Shantae: Half-Genie Hero is a reference to Nikki.
Nikki appears as an Assist Trophy in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate.

Nikki (Papergames).description: Characters from Hello Nikki appeared in Hōnkai Gakuen' 2 as part of a collaboration event.
A costume based on Fox Spirit Matchmaker could be obtained in Love Nikki as part of a special collaboration in China.
A costume based on The King's Woman could be obtained in Love Nikki as part of a special collaboration in China.
Costumes based on Barbie could be obtained in Love Nikki as part of a special collaboration.
Costumes based on Hatsune Miku could be obtained in Love Nikki as part of a special collaboration.
Costumes based on Frozen could be obtained in Love Nikki as part of a special collaboration.
Costumes based on Cardcaptor Sakura could be obtained in Shining Nikki as part of a special collaboration.
Costumes based on Mickey and Minnie Mouse could be obtained in Love Nikki as part of a special collaboration.
A costume based on Cinnamoroll could be obtained in Love Nikki as part of the Sanrio collaboration event.
A costume based on Gudetama could be obtained in Love Nikki as part of the Sanrio collaboration event.
Creatures and accessories based on Stardew Valley appear in Infinity Nikki as part of a special collaboration.

Nimona.description: The Banana Splits theme plays in Nimona.
Nimona and Ballister play a board game that resembles Monopoly in Nimona.
A limited-time event in Roblox allowed players to play as Nimona's transformations.

Nina and the Neurons.description: Nina appears in the Swashbuckle episode "Pirate Party".
Nina appears in the Justin's House episodes "Robert's Inventions", "Robert Gets Converted" and "The Mystery Pong".

Nine Songs of the Moving Heavens.description: Nine Songs of the Moving Heavens is a prequel series to The Legend of Qin.
Characters from Nine Songs of the Moving Heavens appear in A Dream of Jiang Hu.

Nineteen Eighty-Four.description: The Italian comic Zio Paperone e il Grande Papero is a parody of the novel.
A 1984 book is shown in episode 3339 of Sesame Street.
It is said the Doctor has the 1st edition of 1984 in the novel Business Unusual by Gary Russell.

A copy of 1984 can be found amongst garbage in Half-Life 2 (contained in the texture "Garbage001a 01 1984".) 1984 is the inspiration behind multiple elements of Half-Life 2 and is referenced throughout the game.
Episode 1 of Life Is Strange features a reference to Nineteen Eighty-Four.
An image macro can be found reading "BIG BROTHER IS WATCHING YOU" on the walls in Watch Dogs 2.
1984 is mentioned in the SAC 2045 episode "Revolution Of The Fourteen Year Olds".

Ninja Commando.description: The character Dr. Brown from Ninja Commando appears as a recurring secondary character in the World Heroes series, the Ninja Commando character Ryu Eagle is said to be a descendant of Fuuma Kojiro from World Heroes, and the enemy character Spider strongly resembles the final boss in World Heroes 2 Jet, Zeus.
Rayar Dragon and Ryu Eagle from Ninja Commando appear in some minigames.
Characters from Ninja Commando are featured in SNK vs. Capcom: Card Fighters DS.

Ninja Gaiden.description: Ryu meets Mario from Super Mario Bros. in the 1989 flyer, Catch the Title Wave.
Ryu meets a football player from Tecmo Bowl in the 1989 flyer, Catch the Title Wave. There is an ad for Ninja Gaiden in the scoreboard from the NES port of Tecmo Bowl.
Ryu meets Fester from The Addams Family in the 1989 flyer, Catch the Title Wave.
Ryu meets Michelangelo from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles in the 1989 flyer, Catch the Title Wave.
One of the Howard & Nester comics talks about Ninja Gaiden.

Ryu Hayabusa from Ninja Gaiden is a recurring character in the Dead or Alive series, while Muramasa appears in Dead or Alive 4 and 5, Irene Lew appears in Dead or Alive Dimensions, and Momiji and Rachel appear in Dead or Alive 5 Ultimate. Ayane is a recurring character in the modern Ninja Gaiden series, Kasumi is selectable in Ninja Gaiden III: Razor's Edge and several characters from Dead or Alive appear as cards in Ninja Gaiden Clans.

Arino plays the NES Ninja Gaiden in Episode 29 of GameCenter CX, and the NES Ninja Gaiden II in Episodes 96 and 97 and Ninja Gaiden III as part of the GameCenter CX in Pacific special episode. The "Robot Ninja Haggleman" fictional video games within Retro Game Challenge for Nintendo DS are inspired in the classic Ninja Gaiden series.
In Halo 3 there is an armor called the "Hayabusa Powered Assault Armor" named after Ryu Hayabusa from Ninja Gaiden, together with an unlockable replica of Ryu's Dragon Sword.
Ryu Hayabusa appears in I Wanna Be The Guy.
Ryu Hayabusa's costume is an unlockable outfit in Super Swing Golf: Season 2.

Ryu Hayabusa and Momiji from Ninja Gaiden are guest characters in Dynasty Warriors: Strikeforce, and Ryu is playable in Dynasty Warriors Vs., while Ryu, Momiji and Rachel are playable in Warriors Orochi 3 and  Warriors Orochi 3 Ultimate, and Ryu and Ayane are playable in Warriors All-Stars. Ryu's costume is also available as DLC in Dynasty Warriors Online and Ninja Gaiden Sigma 2 features four costumes from Warriors characters.
3D Dot Game Heroes features loading screens based on Ninja Gaiden and Ninja Gaiden II.
A pinball table based on Ninja Gaiden was added to the Pinball FX series starting with Zen Pinball that features characters from the series.
The eighty-seventh episode of The Angry Video Game Nerd is a review of Ninja Gaiden.
The World 4 intro in Super Meat Boy is a parody of the intro from the NES Ninja Gaiden.
Ryu Hayabusa has been a subject for Death Battle!
A skin of Beck from Mighty No. 9 is selectable in Yaiba: Ninja Gaiden Z.

The character Seiji Muramasa from Nioh resembles Muramasa from the Ninja Gaiden series and is implied he may be an ancestor; the characters Jin Hayabusa from the Nioh DLC "Bloodshed's End" and Ren Hayabusa from Nioh 2 are also implied to be ancestors of Ryu Hayabusa, and there are references to the Ninja Dragon Clan as well. A skin based on Ryu Hayabusa appears in Nioh 2 as part of an update.
Two items called Hayabusa Boots and Hayabusa Gloves can be found in Dead Cells.
Sam owns "Nintendo Power V15", which has Ninja Gaiden II on the cover.
Ryu Hayabusa has been a subject for DBX.
A Ninja Gaiden game box is seen in the Melvins Macabre episode "NOSTALGIA".

Ninja Hattori.game: We are Manga-ka: The Tokiwa-so Story
Ninja Hattori.description: Kanzo Hattori from Ninja Hattori makes a cameo appearance in We are Manga-ka: The Tokiwa-so Story.

It's the '82 New Year! Doraemon ・ Kaibutsu-kun ・ Ninja Hattori-kun is a special that contains both series. UNDIRECT: Ninja Hattori eats New Year's Eve Noodles with Doraemon and Q-Taro in a promotional video.
A thought in Super Mario RPG references Ninja Hattori-kun.
As part of special collaboration events, Puzzle & Dragons featured a dungeon with creatures from Ninja Hattori.

Ninja High School.description: Speed Racer has a comic book crossover with Ninja High School.
Gold Digger has a comic book crossover with Ninja High School.
A thin and full-body version of Cookie Monster appears in Ninja High School #94.
Jenna has a comic book crossover with Ninja High School.

Ninja Warriors.description: The main character's endo-skeletons in The Ninja Warriors are designed after the Terminator.
One of the players in the "Taito Planets" team from Super Kyuukyoku Harikiri Stadium 2 is named "NINJA", after the series.
Taiko no Tatsujin: Go! Go! Godaime and later games in the series feature a music track from The Ninja Warriors.
The kunoichi sprite from The Ninja Warriors makes a brief cameo in Chapter 31 of High Score Girl .
A remixed theme of "Daddy Mulk" from The Ninja Warriors is featured in Groove Coaster 2.
A remixed theme of "Daddy Mulk" from The Ninja Warriors is featured in maimai GreeN.

The main characters from The Ninja Warriors appear among the characters providing assist attacks in Arkanoid vs. Space Invaders, while Round 32 in Arkanoid Returns is patterned after the kunoichi from The Ninja Warriors.
The main characters from The Ninja Warriors appear among the characters providing assist attacks in Arkanoid vs. Space Invaders.
Music from The Ninja Warriors can be played in D4DJ Groovy Mix after an update.
Arino plays the Sega CD port of The Ninja Warriors in episode 373.

Ninjago.description: Ninjago was added as a world in Lego Universe.
LEGO Battles: Ninjago is a crossover between both series.
Many characters from Lego Minifigures appear in the Ninjago series; the Lego Ninjago Movie collectable minifigures series is part of both series.
LEGO Battles: Ninjago features the Alien Commander from Lego Mars Mission as an unlockable character.
LEGO Battles: Ninjago features the Lance Spears from Lego Atlantis as an unlockable character.
LEGO Battles: Ninjago features the Rex from Lego Power Miners as an unlockable character;The Geolix and Tremorox rock monster figure designs are used on the Craglings.
LEGO Battles: Ninjago features the Police Officer from Lego City as an unlockable character;Lego City Adventures is mentioned in the Ninjago bonus episode "Dream Team".
LEGO Battles: Ninjago features the Agent Chase from Lego Agents as an unlockable character.
LEGO Battles: Ninjago features the Anubis Guard from Lego Pharaoh's Quest as an unlockable character.
The Illuma-Swords from Ninjago are likely a reference to the lightsabers from Star Wars.
An Alien Clinger hat can be seen in the Ninjago episode "Child's Play".
Lloyd appears in the LEGO Movie series; the short Enter the Ninjago as well as The LEGO Ninjago Movie and its sets, shorts and game are part of both series.
Ninjago is mentioned in TV Star.
The title of the short Enter the Ninjago most likely references Enter the Dragon.
Tox and Paleman, originally from the Ultra Agents theme, appear in the Ninjago series.
Roblox sponsored Ninjago with clothing and accessories.

A crossover short between the two series was written but never produced; Nya's original phoenix symbol is present at the Phoenix Temple; characters from Chima make cameos in the Ninjago episodes Curseworld Part 2, The Kaiju Protocol and Ninjago Confidential;  A 1x2 tile representing a card of Laval from Chima is included in the set 70620 Ninjago City. Legends of Chima is mentioned in the Ninjago bonus episode "Dream Team"; Chima was revealed to be part of the Wyldness from Ninjago:Dragons Rising.
The Ninjago Universe appears in the game.
In the Lego Friends of Heartlake City episode "Anrea's Big Moment", a painting can be seen featuring Nya from Ninjago. Lego Friends is mentioned in the Ninjago bonus episode "Dream Team".

Ninjago is referenced in the Nexo Knights episode, "The Golden Castle,"; Craglings from Ninjago appear as illusions in the Nexo Knights episode, "The Maze of Amazement." Nexo Knights is mentioned in the Ninjago bonus episode "Dream Team".
Lego Worlds features the Earth Driller as well as a Ninjago themed DLC.
Characters from Ninjago appear in Lego Quest & Collect.
A 1x2 tile representing a card of Johnny Thunder from Lego Adventurers is included in the set 70620 Ninjago City.
A 1x2 tile representing a card of Sparks from Lego Rock Raiders is included in the set 70620 Ninjago City.
From The LEGO Ninjago Movie onwards Rufus McCallister wears a Galidor shirt, a poster of the theme is also included in the set 70620 Ninjago City.
In The LEGO Ninjago Movie a Ninjago High School student wears a Blacktron shirt.
Dina mentions Lego Ninjago in Season 3, Episode 1 of Superstore, “Grand Re-Opening”.
the sets 70657 Ninjago City Docks and 71799 Ninjago City Markets refrerence BIONICLE;BIONICLE is mentioned in the Ninjago bonus episode "Dream Team".
Clutch Powers is mentioned in the Ninjago episode "The Royal Blacksmiths". He later becomes a recurring character in the 2019 series.
Characters from Ninjago appear as playable characters in Lego Brawls.
A Minecraft version of Kai from Ninjago is included as a minifigure in the set 21160 The Illager Raid.
The fictional video game Conic the Rat Boy in Ninjago is a reference to the Sonic series.
The fictional video game Counter in Ninjago is a reference to the Contra series.
Characters from the Ninjago series are obtainable characters in Lego Legacy: Heroes Unboxed.
A sticker featuring art for the Lego Space Police theme appears in the set 71741: Ninjago City Gardens.
A series of promotional videos as well as the Ninjago bonus episode "Dream Team" featured characters from Lego Dreamzzz. Lego Dreamzzz features several other references to Ninjago as well.
Monkie Kid is mentioned in the Ninjago bonus episode "Dream Team".

Fortnite: LEGO released a Ninjago themed gamemode titled Fortnite LEGO: Battle Arena which includes the character Lloyd, Spinjitzu and locations from the series. Kai appears as a part of Ninjago LEGO pass.
Outfits based on Ninjago can be found in Lego Horizon Adventures.
Characters and board based on Ninjago appear in Lego Party!.

Ninjala.description: Sonic outfits are featured in Ninjala.
Characters from Ninjala appeared in Puzzle & Dragons during the eleventh GungHo collaboration, while outfits from Puzzle & Dragons appeared in Ninjala during a collaboration event.
The Uncle Death Mask and LID Logo Tee are featured in Ninjala.
Monster Hunter Rise outfits are featured in Ninjala.
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba outfits are featured in Ninjala.
Hatsune Miku outfits are featured in Ninjala.
Rurouni Kenshin outfits are featured in Ninjala.
Jujutsu Kaisen outfits are featured in Ninjala.
Tokyo Revengers outfits are featured in Ninjala.
Outfits and emotes based on Attack on Titan are featured in Ninjala.
Cosmetics based on Evangelion appear in Ninjala as part of a collaboration event.

A costume based on the Bunny from Nintendo Badge Arcade was added to Jump Rope Challenge with Update 1.1.0.

A microgame version of Nintendo Badge Arcade is featured in WarioWare: Get It Together!, with Wario characters directly interacting with it; Nintendo Badge Arcade also features badges based on the WarioWare series.

Nintendo Labo.description: Jingles from Super Mario Bros. are used as examples during the tutorial for the Piano Toy-Con from the Nintendo Labo Variety Kit. Mario Kart 8 Deluxe is compatible with the Motorbike Toy-Con from the Variety Kit and the Steering Wheel Toy-Con from the Nintendo Labo Vehicle Kit. Super Mario Odyssey is compatible with the Nintendo Labo VR Kit.
Scott the Woz once talked about Nintendo Labo.
Deemo is compatible with the Piano Toy-Con from the Nintendo Labo Variety Kit.
Yoshi's Crafted World features cosmetics based on Nintendo Labo.
The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild is compatible with the Nintendo Labo VR Kit.
Nintendo Labo spirits are featured in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate. Super Smash Bros. Ultimate is compatible with the Nintendo Labo VR Kit.
Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker is compatible with the Nintendo Labo VR Kit.
Laid-Back Camp Virtual: Lake Motosu and Laid-Back Camp Virtual: Fumoto Campsite are compatible with the Nintendo Labo VR Kit.

Nintendo Land.description: Nintendo Land features a minigame based on the Zelda series.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on the Metroid series.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on the Pikmin series.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on the Mario series.
The "Luigi's Ghost Mansion" minigame in Nintendo Land is based on Luigi's Mansion, and Professor E. Gadd is heavily implied to be the one describing the different courses.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on the Animal Crossing series.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on Donkey Kong.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on the F-Zero series.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on Balloon Fight.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on the Yoshi series.
Nintendo Land features a minigame based on Octopus.
Nintendo Land features a mini game based on Nazo no Murasame Jo.
If a Mii is given a Wii U in Tomodachi Life, they will sometimes play games that sounds like and resemble attractions from Nintendo Land.
Monita appears as a trophy in Super Smash Bros. for Wii U and then as a spirit in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate.

Nintendo Puzzle Collection.description: Nintendo Puzzle Collection includes a remake of Dr. Mario.
Nintendo Puzzle Collection includes a remake of Yoshi's Cookie.
Nintendo Puzzle Collection includes a remake of Panel de Pon.

Nintendo Switch 2 Welcome Tour.description: A 4K demo of 1-1 from Super Mario Bros. is playable. A Mario amiibo is shown several times, a stylized version of 1-1 is shown to demonstrate ray tracing, 1UP and coin sounds can play via HD Rumble 2, Super Mario Land, Super Mario Bros. Deluxe, and Mario Pinball Land are used to showcase cartridges. Mario Kart Wii is a selectable answer for the first Nintendo game that involved a steering wheel. Mario Kart Live: Home Circuit is shown to represent cameras usage.
WarioWare Twisted is shown as an example of rumble usage.
Various Pokémon games are shown as an example of rumble usage and social connectivity. A Poké Ball Plus is shown as an example of Nintendo controllers that use rumble.
Animal Crossing: City Folk is shown as an example of social connectivity throughout Nintendo's history and is listed as a quiz answer.
Drill Dozer is shown as an example of rumble usage.
The Chase Mii minigame is shown as an example of camera usage.
AR Games is shown as an example of camera usage.

Nintendo Wars.description: A character resembling Samus makes a cameo in Famicom Wars.
Soldiers and MD Tanks from Advance Wars are an Assist Trophy in Super Smash Bros. Brawl and its sequels.
The Famicom Wars Soldiers make an appearance in Captain Rainbow.
A microgame version of Advance Wars is featured in WarioWare: D.I.Y. Showcase.

Nintendo World Championships.description: A version of Super Mario Bros. is included in Nintendo World Championships. Versions of Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. 2, Super Mario Bros. 3, and Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels are included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition
A version of Tetris for the NES is included in Nintendo World Championships.
The 104th episode of The Angry Video Game Nerd is a review of Nintendo World Championships.
NES Remix 2 includes a "Championship mode" also known as "Nintendo World Championships Remix".
A version of Balloon Fight for the NES is included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition.
A version of Donkey Kong for the NES is included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition.
A version of Ice Climber for the NES is included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition.
A version of Kid Icarus for the NES is included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition.
A version of Kirby's Adventure for the NES is included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition.
A version of Metroid for the NES is included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition.
Versions of The Legend of Zelda and Zelda II: The Adventure of Link for the NES are included in Nintendo World Championships: NES Edition.

Nintendogs.description: A toy Bulborb from Pikmin makes an appearance in some shops in Nintendogs; A Pikmin hat is featured in Nintendogs + Cats.
Files based on Nintendogs were obtainable by completing a level in UPIXO in Action: Mission in Snowdriftland.
Microgame versions of Nintendogs are featured in WarioWare: Smooth Moves and WarioWare Gold.
A Nintendog is an Assist Trophy in Super Smash Bros. Brawl and its sequels, with Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS also featuring a stage based on Nintendogs + Cats.
Puppet versions of Nintendogs are featured in Animal Crossing: City Folk.
Link's hat is featured in Nintendogs + Cats.
A Kirby hat is featured in Nintendogs + Cats.
Samus' helmet is featured in Nintendogs + Cats.
Kid Icarus: Uprising features references to the Nintendogs series.
Nintendogs appear in Super Mario Odyssey. Many items from the Mario series are unlockable in the various Nintendogs games.

Nintendoji.description: Nintendoji Kageshina Kurabe appears as a spirit in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate; he's also a trophy in Super Smash Bros. for Nintendo 3DS.

Nioh.description: The character Seiji Muramasa from Nioh resembles Muramasa from the Ninja Gaiden series and is implied he may be an ancestor; the characters Jin Hayabusa from the Nioh DLC "Bloodshed's End" and Ren Hayabusa from Nioh 2 are also implied to be ancestors of Ryu Hayabusa, and there are references to the Ninja Dragon Clan as well. A skin based on Ryu Hayabusa appears in Nioh 2 as part of an update.
Nobunaga Oda makes an appearance in Nioh and Nioh 2.
William Adams from Nioh appears as a playable character in Warriors All-Stars.
The Nioh 2 DLC "The First Samurai" includes a boss battle against Nyotengu from Dead or Alive, under the name "Ancient Nyotengu".
Nioh 2 x Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a crossover between the two Team Ninja video games: Nioh 2 and Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty.
A costume based on William Adams from Nioh can be found in Astro Bot.

Nisekoi.description: Nisekyū!! is a crossover between both series.
