The Zero Wing quote "Somebody set us up the bomb" is used in Armada.
Foxy says "All your base are belong to us" in the game over screen of the Foxy.exe minigame in FNAF World update two.

Zero the Kamikaze Squirrel.description: Zero the Kamikaze Squirrel is a spinoff of Aero the Acro-Bat.

Zettai Karen Children.description: Taiko no Tatsujin 12 features a music track from Zettai Karen Children.
Sunday VS Magazine: Shuuketsu! Choujou Daikessen! features characters from Zettai Karen Children.
The Nostalgia Critic makes a cameo in the Zettai Karen Children: The Unlimited episode "Strangers".
The Angry Video Game Nerd makes a cameo in the Zettai Karen Children: The Unlimited episode "Strangers".
The Duel Masters card Pretty Children features Kaoru Akashi, Aoi Nogami and Shiho Sannomiya from Zettai Karen Children.

Zhu Xiao Pi.description: Zhu Xiao Pi appears in Kaku Spring Festival Gala 2019.

Zoey 101.description: Stacey Dillsen from Zoey 101 appears in the iCarly episodes "iStart a Fanwar" and "iHire An Idiot".
Stacey Dillsen from Zoey 101 appears in the Sam & Cat episode "#MadAboutShoe", while Coco and Carl appear in the episode: "#FirstClassProblems".
Blix from Zoey 101 can be seen in the background of the Girl Meets World episode "Girl Meets Master Plan".

Zoids.description: Spider-Man and Zoids comics have been printed together.
The Super Robot Wars series features units from the Zoids series.
The Ask Vector Prime Facebook pages confirms Zoids is part of the Transformers multiverse.
Van Flyheight appeared in Puzzle & Dragons during a special CoroCoro collaboration event.
The Duel Masters card Beast Liger, Legendary Zoid features Beast Liger from Zoids.
The Zoids model " ZW01 Wild Liger Ashe Model w/Custom Labels" feature stickers based on Phantasy Star Online 2, and includes a product code for Zoids accessories in Phantasy Star Online 2.
Blade Liger, Shield Liger, Command Wolf, Geno Saurer, and Death Saurer from Zoids appear in Medabots S as part of a collaboration event.
ZOIDS × PATLABOR Code Name BUDDY is a crossover between the two series.

Zombie Cafe.description: Resident Evil 6 characters appeared in Zombie Cafe as part of several special promotions.
Ghosts 'n Goblins characters appeared in Zombie Cafe as part of two special promotions.
Mega Man and Mega Man X characters appeared in Zombie Cafe as part of several special promotions.
Darkstalkers characters appeared in Zombie Cafe as part of several special promotions.
Devil May Cry characters appeared in Zombie Cafe as part of two special promotions.

Zombie Land Saga.description: Music from Zombie Land Saga can be played in WACCA.
Music from Zombie Land Saga can be played in O.N.G.E.K.I. Summer.
Music from Zombie Land Saga was added to maimai in the maimai DX version.
Zombie Land Saga characters appear in World Flipper for a collaboration event.
Super Robot Wars X-Ω features units from Zombie Land Saga.
Characters from THE iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls: Starlight Stage wear the costumes labeled as “Zombie Heart” and sing “Adabana Necromancy” for a collaboration event.
Characters from Zombie Land Saga appear in BanG Dream! Girls Band Party! during a collaboration event.
Characters from Zombie Land Saga appear in Rage of Bahamut during a collaboration event.
Characters from Zombie Land Saga appear in Girls' Frontline as part of a collaboration event.

Zombieland (Sony).description: World of Warcraft appears in Zombieland.
Footage from Ghostbusters appears in Zombieland.
Garfield is mentioned in Zombieland and Zombieland: Double Tap.
Sarah Conner and Kyle Reese from Terminator is mentioned in the Zombieland: The Series pilot. Zombies are also nicknamed "T-800" in Zombieland: Double Tap.
Ms. Pac-Man is mentioned in the Zombieland: The Series pilot
Bobby Brady from The Brady Bunch is mentioned in the Zombieland: The Series pilot
Zombies are nicknamed "Homer" in Zombieland: Double Tap.

Zombies (Disney).description: Characters and locations from Zombies appear in Chibi Tiny Tales.
Zed and Addison from Zombies are playable characters in Disney All Star Party.
Zed and Addison from Zombies appear in Disney All-Stars Racers.

Zombies Ate My Neighbors.description: Zombies Ate My Neighbors features an enemy named "Vlad Belmont the Vampire".
Purple Tentacles appear in a bonus level in Zombies Ate My Neighbors.
In The Curse of Monkey Island the gravedigger Mort has a book titled " Zombies ate my neighbours".
In the Eddsworld episode "EW Halloween Special", Edd and Tord are playing Zombies Ate My Neighbors.
The Irate Gamer reviews Zombies Ate My Neighbors

Zombies vs Robots.description: Zombies vs Robots appear in the Infestation Crossover event.
Mars Attacks has a crossover with Zombies vs Robots.

Zone Fighter.description: Godzilla, Gigan, and King Ghidorah all made appearances in a few episodes of Zone Fighter.

Zone of the Enders.description: Zone of the Enders included a demo of Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of the Patriots. There are also several minor references to the series in Metal Gear games.
Dingo and Ken from Zone of the Enders appear in Pop'n Music 8; a track from Zone of the Enders: The 2nd Runner also appears in the game.
The Vic Viper that Leo pilots in Zone of the Enders: The 2nd Runner is a variant of the Vic Viper from Gradius. The 2nd Runner also contains a parody of Gradius called Zoradius.

Two DLC bombermen from Super Bomberman R (added in Ver.2.0) known respectively "Anubis Bomber" and "Jehuty Bomber", are based off Orbital Frames from Zone of the Enders, while Ver.2.1 added "Vic Viper Zero Bomber", based on another of the series' mechas.
Jehuty from Zone of the Enders appears as a summon in Granblue Fantasy as part of a collaboration.

Zool.description: In the ending of Zool: Ninja of the Nth Dimension, Zool kicks a blue hedgehog with red sneakers meant to represent Sonic.
The ledges and climbing mechanic in Zool: Ninja of the Nth Dimension are inspired by Strider.
The boss Zoonik in Jazz Jackrabbit is partially based on Zool.
The Angry Video Game Nerd reviews the Amiga CD32 game Zool in the 162nd episode of the show.

Zoomer the Hedgehog.description: Zoomer the Hedgehog features parodies of Sonic characters.
A character from Zoomer the Hedgehog appears in the Anime Weebs episode "The Fate of all Weebs".

Zoophobia.description: The Jaws Poster Can be spotted In Jack's Locker

Some names of characters as well as Blitzo's mark from "Helluva Boss" can be seen on books in the library scene in Zoophobia. A plush of Jack from Zoophobia can also be seen in the Helluva Boss episode "C.H.E.R.U.B."
Some names of characters from "Hazbin Hotel" can be seen on books in the library scene in Zoophobia.

Zootopia.description: Miss Piggy and Kermit attend to the premiere of Zootopia in the Muppets episode "Tail Of Two Piggies".
In a limited-time event in Roblox, players could enter the world of Zootopia and get Zootopia-themed gear.
A poster of Zootopia can be seen on the background at a cinema in the Middle episode "Hecks At A Movie".
Accessories based on Zootopia appeared in Webkinz as part of a special collaboration.
Characters from Zootopia are playable in Disney Infinity 3.0.
Judy Hopps' MP3 playlist has the song "Part Of Your Wool" in Zootopia. An allusion to "Part Of Your World" from Little Mermaid.
A theater marquee with the "Star Trunk" title is shown next to Jumbeaux's Cafe in Zootopia.
A Mickey Mouse doll makes a small appearance in the movie Zootopia.
A parody of Frozen titled "Floatzen 2" makes a small appearance within the movie Zootopia; two baby elephants dressed as Anna and Elsa also make a cameo.
The Lucky Cat Cafe from Big Hero 6 appears in the film, Zootopia; there is also a calendar showing San Fransokyo, and the cover for a movie titled "Pig Hero 6".
A parody of Tangled titled "Wrangled" makes a small appearance within the movie Zootopia.
A parody of Moana titled "Meowana" makes a small appearance within the movie Zootopia.
Graffiti of Oswald can be seen on a subway train in Zootopia.
There are references to Breaking Bad in Zootopia.
Disney Crossy Road has Zootopia characters.
Characters can dress up as Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. Medals of Judy Hopps, Nick Wilde, and Flash also appear in the game.
Club Penguin held a Zootopia Party.
Taiko no Tatsujin Red version with its updates, Session de Dodon ga Don!, and Nintendo Switch Version! feature a music track from Zootopia.
Zootopia is mentioned in the Big Bang Theory episode "The Locomotion Reverberation".
Disney Magic Kingdoms features characters from Zootopia.
Zootopia is parodied in the Robot Chicken episode "Scoot To The Gute".
Disney Heroes: Battle Mode features characters from Zootopia.
Nick Wilde and Judy Hopps make cameos in Ralph Breaks the Internet; a parody of Wreck-It Ralph titled "Wreck-It Rhino" makes a small appearance within the movie Zootopia.
Judy Hopps from Zootopia is a fighter in Disney Sorcerer's Arena.
Zootopia is parodied in the Papa Meat episode "A Zootopia love Story".
Zootopia is parodied in "How Zootopia Should Have Ended".
Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde appear in the credits for Wish.
Cards based on Zootopia appear in Lorcana.
Characters from Zootopia appear in Eggy Party.
Zootopia 2 has a reference to Ratatouille.
There will be a puzzle in Disney Solitare that shows a scene from Zootopia.

Zorbie.description: Zorbie is a playable character in Indie Pogo.

Zorro.description: The comic story Operação P.I. 1820 can be considered a crossover between the two series; A character dressed as Zorro, called Little Zorro is featured in some Mickey Mouse strips from 1958 and Zorro can also be seen on TV in a Mickey Mouse comic strip from April 24, 1958 and one from May 15, 1958.
Lady Rawhide is a spin-off of Zorro; Lady Rawhide nd Lady Zorro also had a crossover comic.
A character is dressed up as Zorro in Never Been Kissed.
In Amélie, Amélie Poulain dresses up as Zorro.

Zuma.description: The ball chasing Warren in the "Great Balls of Ire" level in Peggle Nights is from Zuma; several other levels from this Stage contain references to Zuma.

There is a Blitz level in the DS version of Zuma's Revenge based on the Yard from Plants vs Zombies in which the zombies occasionally appear. Baron Digo and Stone Spheres From Zuma's Revenge appear in the Achievement Menu of Plants vs. Zombies: Game of the Year Edition.
Zuma is included as a bonus game in the PlayStation 3 version of Bejeweled 3, while Bejeweled 3 is included as a bonus game in the Xbox 360 version of Zuma's Revenge.
